223: static int send_slot(struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
224:                      uint32_t *order)
225: {
226:   uint32_t wire[2];
227:   int ret;
228: 
229:   *order = ++g_send_order;
230:   wire[0] = (uint32_t)(uintptr_t)message;
231:   wire[1] = sizeof(*message);
232:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
233:   ret = bk7258_mbox_send(0, wire);
234:   if (ret == OK)
235:     {
236:       g_stats.tx++;
237:     }
238:   else if (ret == -EAGAIN)
239:     {
240:       g_stats.fifo_full++;
241:     }
242: 
243:   if (ret < 0)
244:     {
245:       g_stats.last_tx_error = (uint32_t)(-ret);
246:     }
247: 
248:   return ret;
249: }

286: static void complete_transaction(struct active_transaction *active,
287:                                  const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
288:                                  int result)
289: {
290:   struct logical_channel *channel = NULL;
291: 
292:   if (active->channel_index < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
293:     {
294:       channel = &g_channels[active->channel_index];
295:       channel->queued = false;
296:       channel->result = result;
297:     }
298: 
299:   active->busy = false;
300:   if (result == OK)
301:     {
302:       release_acks_before(active->order);
303:     }
304: 
305:   if (active->callback != NULL)
306:     {
307:       active->callback(ack, result, active->arg);
308:     }
309: }

311: static void fail_pending(int result)
312: {
313:   unsigned int i;
314: 
315:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
316:     {
317:       struct logical_channel *channel = &g_channels[i];
318: 
319:       if (channel->queued)
320:         {
321:           channel->queued = false;
322:           channel->result = result;
323:           if (channel->callback != NULL)
324:             {
325:               channel->callback(NULL, result, channel->arg);
326:             }
327:         }
328:     }
329: }

332: {
333:   unsigned int i;
334: 
335:   g_active.quarantine = false;
336:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
337:     {
338:       memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
339:     }

342: static void select_recovery_epoch(void)
343: {
344:   unsigned int i;
345:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = NULL;
346: 
347:   for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
348:     {
349:       if (!g_recovery[i].probe.quarantine &&
350:           !g_recovery[i].reset_sent && !g_recovery[i].probe.busy)
351:         {
352:           epoch = &g_recovery[i];
353:           g_recovery_index = i;
354:           break;
355:         }
356:     }
357: 
358:   if (epoch == NULL)
359:     {
360:       uint32_t newest = 0;
361: 
362:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
363:         {
364:           if (g_recovery[i].probe.order >= newest)
365:             {
366:               newest = g_recovery[i].probe.order;
367:               epoch = &g_recovery[i];
368:               g_recovery_index = i;
369:             }
370:         }
371: 
372:       epoch->replay = true;
373:       g_stats.recovery_replay++;
374:     }
375:   else
376:     {
377:       memset(epoch, 0, sizeof(*epoch));
378:       epoch->reset.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
379:         0, 0, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET, 0,
380:         BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX);
381:     }
382: 
383:   g_probe_attempts = 0;
384:   g_reset_pending = !epoch->replay;
385:   g_stats.recovery_cycle++;
386:   set_link_state(epoch->replay ? BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING :
387:                                  BK7258_MB_LINK_ABORTING);
388: }

390: static void begin_abort(int result)
391: {
392:   struct active_transaction *probe = busy_probe();
393: 
394:   if (g_active.busy)
395:     {
396:       g_active.quarantine = true;
397:       complete_transaction(&g_active, NULL, result);
398:     }
399: 
400:   if (probe != NULL)
401:     {
402:       probe->quarantine = true;
403:       complete_transaction(probe, NULL, result);
404:     }
405: 
406:   fail_pending(result);
407:   g_probe_requested = false;
408:   select_recovery_epoch();

428: static int dispatch_locked(void)
429: {
430:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
431:   struct active_transaction *active;
432:   struct logical_channel *channel;
433:   unsigned int i;
434:   int ret;
435: 
436:   /* ACKs always outrank RESET and ordinary commands. */
437: 
438:   for (i = 0; i < MB_ACK_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
439:     {
440:       if (g_ack_slots[i].state != ACK_SLOT_QUEUED)
441:         {
442:           continue;
443:         }
444: 
445:       ret = send_slot(&g_ack_slots[i].message, &g_ack_slots[i].order);
446:       if (ret < 0)
447:         {
448:           return ret;
449:         }
450: 
451:       g_ack_slots[i].state = ACK_SLOT_SENT;
452:     }
453: 
454:   if (g_reset_pending)
455:     {
456:       ret = send_slot(&epoch->reset, &epoch->reset_order);
457:       if (ret < 0)
458:         {
459:           return ret;
460:         }
461: 
462:       g_reset_pending = false;
463:       epoch->reset_sent = true;
464:       set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING);
465:     }
466: 
467:   if (g_active.busy || busy_probe() != NULL)
468:     {
469:       return OK;
470:     }
471: 
472:   for (i = 0; i < MB_CHANNEL_COUNT; i++)
473:     {
474:       channel = &g_channels[i];
475:       if (!channel->queued)
476:         {
477:           continue;
478:         }
479: 
480:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING)
481:         {
482:           if (g_channel_ids[i] == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
483:               bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending) ==
484:               BK7258_MB_UART_STATE)
485:             {
486:               active = &epoch->probe;
487:             }
488:           else
489:             {
490:               continue;
491:             }
492: 
493:           if (active == &epoch->probe && active->quarantine &&
494:               !epoch->replay)
495:             {
496:               return -ENOLINK;
497:             }
498:         }
499:       else if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
500:         {
501:           active = &g_active;
502:           if (active->quarantine)
503:             {
504:               return -ENOLINK;
505:             }
506:         }
507:       else
508:         {
509:           return OK;
510:         }
511: 
512:       if (!epoch->replay || active != &epoch->probe)
513:         {
514:           memset(&active->message, 0, sizeof(active->message));
515:           memcpy(&active->message, &channel->pending,
516:                  sizeof(active->message));
517:           active->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
518:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&channel->pending),
519:             bk7258_mb_header_state(&channel->pending), 0, ++g_tx_seq,
520:             g_channel_ids[i]);
521:         }
522: 
523:       active->callback = channel->callback;
524:       active->arg = channel->arg;
525:       active->channel_index = i;
526:       active->started = clock_systime_ticks();
527:       active->busy = true;
528:       ret = send_slot(&active->message, &active->order);
529:       if (ret < 0)
530:         {
531:           active->busy = false;
532:           return ret;
533:         }
534: 
535:       if (active == &epoch->probe)
536:         {
537:           if (epoch->first_probe_order == 0)
538:             {
539:               epoch->first_probe_order = active->order;
540:             }
541: 
542:           g_probe_attempts++;
543:           g_stats.probes++;
544:         }
545: 
546:       return OK;
547:     }
548: 
549:   return OK;
550: }

552: static uint32_t ack_header_reason(
553:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
554:   const struct active_transaction *active)
555: {
556:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
557:   uint32_t reason = 0;
558: 
559:   if (!active->busy)
560:     {
561:       return 1u;
562:     }
563: 
564:   if (control != BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
565:     {
566:       reason |= 2u;
567:     }
568:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) !=
569:       bk7258_mb_header_channel(&active->message))
570:     {
571:       reason |= 4u;
572:     }
573:   if (bk7258_mb_header_seq(message) !=
574:       bk7258_mb_header_seq(&active->message))
575:     {
576:       reason |= 8u;
577:     }
578:   if (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) !=
579:       bk7258_mb_header_cmd(&active->message))
580:     {
581:       reason |= 16u;
582:     }
583: 
584:   return reason;
585: }

587: static bool valid_uart_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
588: {
589:   return (message->payload_address & ~3u) == 0 &&
590:          message->payload_length == 0 && message->flags == 0 &&
591:          message->crc8 == 0 && message->reserved == 0;
592: }
593: 
594: static void handle_ack(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
595: {
596:   struct recovery_epoch *epoch = current_recovery();
597:   struct active_transaction *active;
598:   bool replay;
599:   int result;
600:   uint32_t reason;
601: 
602: 
603:   active = busy_probe();
604:   if (active == NULL)
605:     {
606:       active = &g_active;
607:     }
608: 
609:   g_stats.last_ack_header = message->header;
610:   g_stats.last_active_header = active->message.header;
611:   reason = ack_header_reason(message, active);
612:   if (reason != 0)
613:     {
614:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
615:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= reason;
616:       return;
617:     }
618: 
619: 
620:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
621:       !valid_uart_ack(message))
622:     {
623:       /* Keep active stable.  A malformed ACK is not an ownership proof. */
624: 
625:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
626:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 32u;
627:       return;
628:     }
629: 
630:   if ((bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & ~BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0)
631:     {
632:       g_stats.bad_ack++;
633:       g_stats.bad_ack_reason |= 64u;
634:       return;
635:     }
636: 
637:   result = (bk7258_mb_header_state(message) & BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL) != 0 ?
638:            -EREMOTEIO : OK;
639: 
640:   if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
641:       result == OK && (message->payload_address & 2u) != 0)
642:     {
643:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
644:     }
645: 
646:   replay = active == &epoch->probe && epoch->replay;
647:   release_acks_before(replay ? epoch->first_probe_order : active->order);
648:   if (replay)
649:     {
650:       unsigned int replay_index = g_recovery_index;
651:       unsigned int i;
652: 
653:       /* This ACK may be a late ACK for the original copy.  It proves every
654:        * older epoch was copied, but not that the new replay envelope was
655:        * copied.  Preserve the replay epoch, free only older epochs, and use
656:        * one of them for a fresh-sequence confirmation probe.
657:        */
658: 
659:       complete_transaction(active, message, -EAGAIN);
660:       g_active.quarantine = false;
661:       for (i = 0; i < MB_RECOVERY_SLOT_COUNT; i++)
662:         {
663:           if (i != replay_index)
664:             {
665:               memset(&g_recovery[i], 0, sizeof(g_recovery[i]));
666:             }
667:         }
668: 
669:       select_recovery_epoch();
670:       (void)dispatch_locked();
671:       return;
672:     }
673: 
674:   complete_transaction(active, message, result);
675: 
676:   if (active == &epoch->probe)
677:     {
678:       if (result == OK && (message->flags & 2u) == 0)
679:         {
680:           release_recovery_slots();
681:           g_recovery_index = 0;
682:           g_probe_attempts = 0;
683:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_READY);
684:         }
685:       else if (result == -EREMOTEIO &&
686:                g_probe_attempts < MB_PROBE_MAX_ATTEMPTS)
687:         {
688:           /* CP may not have opened MB_UART0 yet.  The matched ACK proves
689:            * that this probe slot is no longer referenced by its FIFO.
690:            */
691:         }
692:       else
693:         {
694:           g_stats.probe_fail++;
695:           epoch->probe.quarantine = result == -ETIMEDOUT;
696:           set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
697:         }
698:     }
699: 
700:   else if (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
701:            result < 0)
702:     {
703:       begin_abort(result);
704:     }
705: 
706:   (void)dispatch_locked();
707: }

709: static int handle_command(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
710: {
711:   struct ack_slot *slot;
712:   unsigned int rx_index;
713:   uint8_t channel = bk7258_mb_header_channel(message);
714:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
715:   uint8_t ack_flags = 0;
716:   uint8_t state = 0;
717:   int ret = -ENOSYS;
718: 
719:   g_stats.last_command_header = message->header;
720: 
721:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) == 0)
722:     {
723:       slot = alloc_ack_slot();
724:       if (slot == NULL)
725:         {
726:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
727:           return -EAGAIN;
728:         }
729:     }
730:   else
731:     {
732:       slot = NULL;
733:     }
734: 
735:   if ((control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0 ||
736:       bk7258_mb_header_state(message) != 0 ||
737:       (channel & 0xf0u) != 0x40u)
738:     {
739:       g_stats.bad_header++;
740:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
741:     }
742:   else if ((rx_index = rx_channel_index(channel)) < MB_RX_CHANNEL_COUNT &&
743:            g_rx_callbacks[rx_index] != NULL)
744:     {
745:       ret = g_rx_callbacks[rx_index](message, &ack_flags,
746:                                       g_rx_args[rx_index]);
747:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
748:         {
749:           if (slot != NULL)
750:             {
751:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
752:             }
753: 
754:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
755:           return -EAGAIN;
756:         }
757:       else if (ret < 0)
758:         {
759:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
760:         }
761:     }
762:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_PWC_RX && g_pwc_rx != NULL)
763:     {
764:       ret = g_pwc_rx(message);
765:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
766:         {
767:           if (slot != NULL)
768:             {
769:               slot->state = ACK_SLOT_FREE;
770:             }
771: 
772:           g_stats.deferred_command++;
773:           return -EAGAIN;
774:         }
775:       else if (ret < 0)
776:         {
777:           state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
778:         }
779:     }
780:   else if (channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_SARADC_RX &&
781:            (bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 0u ||
782:             bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == 1u) &&
783:            message->payload_address == 1u &&
784:            message->payload_length == 0u && message->flags == 0u &&
785:            message->crc8 == 0u && message->reserved == 0u)
786:     {
787:       /* Match Armino's SARADC operation-notification ABI. */
788:       ack_flags = 2u;
789:       ret = OK;
790:     }
791:   else
792:     {
793:       g_stats.unsupported++;
794:       state = BK7258_MB_STATE_COM_FAIL;
795:     }
796: 
797:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_SYNC_TX) != 0)
798:     {
799:       return OK;
800:     }
801: 
802:   memset(&slot->message, 0, sizeof(slot->message));
803:   slot->message.header = bk7258_mb_make_header(
804:     bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message), state, BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX,
805:     bk7258_mb_header_seq(message), channel);
806:   slot->message.payload_address = ack_flags;
807: 
808:   if (ack_slots_used() >= MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
809:     {
810:       g_probe_requested = true;
811:     }
812: 
813:   (void)dispatch_locked();
814:   return OK;
815: }
816: 
817: static int mailbox_rx(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
818: {
819:   irqstate_t flags;
820:   uint8_t control;
821: 
822:   flags = up_irq_save();
823:   g_stats.rx++;
824:   control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
825: 
826:   if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET) != 0)
827:     {
828:       if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0 ||
829:           (bk7258_mb_header_channel(message) & 0xf0u) != 0x40u ||
830:           (control & ~(BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0)
831:         {
832:           g_stats.bad_header++;
833:         }
834:       else
835:         {
836:           g_stats.resets++;
837:           g_peer_reset_generation++;
838:           bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred();
839:           begin_abort(-ECONNRESET);
840:         }
841:     }
842:   else if ((control & BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX) != 0)
843:     {
844:       handle_ack(message);
845:     }
846:   else
847:     {
848:       int ret = handle_command(message);
849: 
850:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
851:         {
852:           up_irq_restore(flags);
853:           return ret;
854:         }
855:     }
856: 
857:   up_irq_restore(flags);
858:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
859:   return OK;
860: }

862: static int mailbox_diag_worker(int argc, char **argv)
863: {
864:   enum bk7258_mb_link_state reported = BK7258_MB_LINK_QUIESCING;
865: 
866:   (void)argc;
867:   (void)argv;
868: 
869:   for (;;)
870:     {
871:       nxsem_wait_uninterruptible(&g_diag_sem);
872:       nxsem_reset(&g_diag_sem, 0);
873:       irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
874:       enum bk7258_mb_link_state state = g_diag_state;
875:       bk7258_mb_link_callback_t callback = g_link_callback;
876:       void *callback_arg = g_link_arg;
877:       uint32_t timeout = g_stats.timeout;
878:       uint32_t bad_ack = g_stats.bad_ack;
879:       uint8_t epoch = g_recovery_index;
880: 
881:       up_irq_restore(flags);
882:       if (reported == state)
883:         {
884:           continue;
885:         }
886: 
887:       reported = state;
888:       if (reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
889:           reported != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY)
890:         {
891:           syslog(LOG_WARNING,
892:                  "mailbox: link state=%u epoch=%u timeout=%lu bad_ack=%lu\n",
893:                  reported, epoch, (unsigned long)timeout,
894:                  (unsigned long)bad_ack);
895:         }
896: 
897:       if (callback != NULL)
898:         {
899:           callback(reported, callback_arg);
900:         }
901:     }
902: 
903:   return OK;
904: }

906: static int mailbox_tx_worker(int argc, char **argv)
907: {
908:   (void)argc;
909:   (void)argv;
910: 
911:   for (;;)
912:     {
913:       struct active_transaction *probe;
914:       irqstate_t flags;
915:       bool request_probe;
916: 
917:       (void)nxsem_tickwait_uninterruptible(&g_tx_sem, MB_WORK_INTERVAL);
918:       nxsem_reset(&g_tx_sem, 0);
919:       flags = up_irq_save();
920: 
921:       probe = busy_probe();
922:       if ((g_active.busy &&
923:            clock_systime_ticks() - g_active.started >= MB_TIMEOUT) ||
924:           (probe != NULL &&
925:            clock_systime_ticks() - probe->started >= MB_TIMEOUT))
926:         {
927:           g_stats.timeout++;
928:           if (probe != NULL)
929:             {
930:               probe->quarantine = true;
931:               complete_transaction(probe, NULL, -ETIMEDOUT);
932:               g_stats.probe_fail++;
933:               set_link_state(BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN);
934:             }
935:           else
936:             {
937:               begin_abort(-ETIMEDOUT);
938:             }
939:         }
940: 
941:       if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_DOWN &&
942:           clock_systime_ticks() - g_down_since >= MB_DOWN_RETRY)
943:         {
944:           select_recovery_epoch();
945:         }
946: 
947:       (void)dispatch_locked();
948:       if (g_probe_requested && ack_slots_used() < MB_ACK_HIGH_WATER)
949:         {
950:           g_probe_requested = false;
951:         }
952: 
953:       request_probe = g_probe_requested &&
954:                       g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
955:                       !g_channels[4].queued && !g_active.busy;
956:       if (request_probe)
957:         {
958:           g_probe_requested = false;
959:         }
960: 
961:       up_irq_restore(flags);
962: 
963:       if (request_probe)
964:         {
965:           bk7258_mb_uart_request_state();
966:         }
967:     }
968: 
969:   return OK;
970: }

1051: int bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(uint8_t logical_channel,
1052:                              const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message,
1053:                              bk7258_mb_tx_complete_t callback, void *arg)
1054: {
1055:   struct logical_channel *channel;
1056:   unsigned int index;
1057:   irqstate_t flags;
1058: 
1059:   if (!g_initialized || !g_physical_started || message == NULL)
1060:     {
1061:       return -EAGAIN;
1062:     }
1063: 
1064:   index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1065:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)
1066:     {
1067:       return -EINVAL;
1068:     }
1069: 
1070:   flags = up_irq_save();
1071:   channel = &g_channels[index];
1072: 
1073:   if (channel->queued)
1074:     {
1075:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1076:       return -EBUSY;
1077:     }
1078: 
1079:   if (g_link_state != BK7258_MB_LINK_READY &&
1080:       !(g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_PROBING &&
1081:         logical_channel == BK7258_MB_CHAN_UART0_TX &&
1082:         bk7258_mb_header_cmd(message) == BK7258_MB_UART_STATE))
1083:     {
1084:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1085:       return -ENOLINK;
1086:     }
1087: 
1088:   if (g_link_state == BK7258_MB_LINK_READY && g_active.quarantine)
1089:     {
1090:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1091:       return -ENOLINK;
1092:     }
1093: 
1094:   memset(&channel->pending, 0, sizeof(channel->pending));
1095:   memcpy(&channel->pending, message, sizeof(channel->pending));
1096:   channel->callback = callback;
1097:   channel->arg = arg;
1098:   channel->result = -EINPROGRESS;
1099:   channel->queued = true;
1100: 
1101:   (void)dispatch_locked();
1102: 
1103:   up_irq_restore(flags);
1104: 
1105:   nxsem_post(&g_tx_sem);
1106:   return OK;
1107: }

1140:    * a READY link here would abort a valid state ACK and race the first PWC
1141:    * transaction. */

1188: int bk7258_mailbox_wait_link_ready(unsigned int timeout_ms)

1190:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1191:   clock_t next_probe = clock_systime_ticks();
1192: 
1193:   while (!bk7258_mailbox_link_ready())
1194:     {
1195:       clock_t now = clock_systime_ticks();

1203:        * ABORTING -> PROBING worker wakeup was consumed before RESET was
1204:        * dispatched.  This only marks STATE pending; normal transaction
1205:        * serialization remains in the mailbox workers. */
1206:       if ((int32_t)(now - next_probe) >= 0)

1209:            * this retry point.  Do not reopen a link that has just become

1273: static int wait_channel(uint8_t logical_channel, unsigned int timeout_ms)
1274: {
1275:   unsigned int index = channel_index(logical_channel);
1276:   clock_t deadline = clock_systime_ticks() + MSEC2TICK(timeout_ms);
1277: 
1278:   if (index >= MB_CHANNEL_COUNT)

1280:       return -EINVAL;
1281:     }

1283:   for (;;)
1284:     {
1285:       irqstate_t flags;
1286:       bool queued;
1287:       int result;
1288: 
1289:       flags = up_irq_save();
1290:       queued = g_channels[index].queued;
1291:       result = g_channels[index].result;
1292:       up_irq_restore(flags);
1293:       if (!queued)
1294:         {
1295:           return result == -EINPROGRESS ? OK : result;
1296:         }
1297: 
1298:       if ((int32_t)(clock_systime_ticks() - deadline) >= 0)

1308:        * ACK while AP remains asleep waiting for an IRQ-side drain. */

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 Armino-compatible HW_CTRL power-up and heartbeat service.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <stdio.h>
11: #include <string.h>
12: #include <syslog.h>
13: 
14: #include <nuttx/clock.h>
15: #include <nuttx/kthread.h>
16: #include <nuttx/mutex.h>
17: #include <nuttx/signal.h>
18: 
19: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
20: #define IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION   1u
21: #define IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION 2u
22: #define IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE         2u
23: #define IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS        600u
24: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL         MSEC2TICK(2000)
25: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY            MSEC2TICK(100)
26: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US           10000u
27: #define IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY          110
28: 
29: static mutex_t g_ipc_lock = NXMUTEX_INITIALIZER;
30: static volatile int g_ipc_ack_result;
31: static volatile int g_ipc_start_result;
32: static volatile int g_heartbeat_result;
33: static volatile bool g_heartbeat_enabled;
34: static volatile bool g_heartbeat_pending;
35: static volatile uint32_t g_heartbeat_completions;
36: static clock_t g_next_heartbeat;
37: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_failures;
38: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_submissions;
39: static uint32_t g_heartbeat_reported;
40: static bool g_ipc_started;
41: 
42: static int ipc_ack_result(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
43:                           int result)
44: {
45:   if (result == OK &&
46:       (ack == NULL || ack->reserved != IPC_ACK_STATE_COMPLETE))
47:     {
48:       result = -EREMOTEIO;
49:     }
50: 
51:   return result;
52: }
53: 
54: static void ipc_tx_complete(const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack,
55:                             int result, void *arg)
56: {
57:   g_ipc_ack_result = ipc_ack_result(ack, result);
58:   if ((uintptr_t)arg == IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION &&
59:       g_ipc_ack_result == OK)
60:     {
61:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
62:       g_next_heartbeat = clock_systime_ticks() + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
63:       g_heartbeat_enabled = true;
64:     }
65: }
66: 
67: static void ipc_heartbeat_complete(
68:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *ack, int result, void *arg)
69: {
70:   (void)arg;
71:   g_heartbeat_result = ipc_ack_result(ack, result);
72:   g_heartbeat_completions++;
73:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
74: }
75: 
76: static int ipc_send(uint8_t command, uint32_t parameter)
77: {
78:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
79:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
80:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
81:   int ret;
82: 
83:   ret = nxmutex_lock(&g_ipc_lock);
84:   if (ret < 0)
85:     {
86:       return ret;
87:     }
88: 
89:   *payload = parameter;
90:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
91: 
92:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
93:   message.header = command;
94:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
95:   message.payload_length =
96:     command == IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION ? sizeof(*payload) : 0;
97:   g_ipc_ack_result = -EINPROGRESS;
98: 
99:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
100:                                   ipc_tx_complete,
101:                                   (void *)(uintptr_t)command);
102:   if (ret == OK)
103:     {
104:       ret = bk7258_mailbox_wait_hw_control(IPC_RESPONSE_TIMEOUT_MS);
105:       if (ret == OK)
106:         {
107:           ret = g_ipc_ack_result;
108:         }
109:     }
110: 
111:   nxmutex_unlock(&g_ipc_lock);
112:   return ret > 0 ? -EIO : ret;
113: }
114: 
115: static int ipc_heartbeat_worker(int argc, char **argv)
116: {
117:   (void)argc;
118:   (void)argv;
119: 
120:   for (;;)
121:     {
122:       nxsig_usleep(IPC_HEARTBEAT_POLL_US);
123:       bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll();
124:     }
125: 
126:   return OK;
127: }
128: 
129: void bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_poll(void)
130: {
131:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
132:   volatile uint32_t *payload =
133:     (volatile uint32_t *)(uintptr_t)BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
134:   clock_t now;
135:   int ret;
136: 
137:   if (!g_heartbeat_enabled || g_heartbeat_pending)
138:     {
139:       return;
140:     }
141: 
142:   if (g_heartbeat_completions != g_heartbeat_reported)
143:     {
144:       g_heartbeat_reported = g_heartbeat_completions;
145:       if (g_heartbeat_reported <= 3u)
146:         {
147:           printf("IPC: heartbeat ACK result=%d count=%lu\n",
148:                  g_heartbeat_result,
149:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_reported);
150:         }
151:     }
152: 
153:   if (g_heartbeat_result < 0)
154:     {
155:       g_heartbeat_failures++;
156:       if ((g_heartbeat_failures & (g_heartbeat_failures - 1u)) == 0)
157:         {
158:           syslog(LOG_ERR, "IPC heartbeat failed: %d count=%lu\n",
159:                  g_heartbeat_result,
160:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_failures);
161:         }
162: 
163:       g_heartbeat_result = OK;
164:     }
165: 
166:   now = clock_systime_ticks();
167:   if ((sclock_t)(now - g_next_heartbeat) < 0)
168:     {
169:       return;
170:     }
171: 
172:   *payload = 0;
173:   __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
174:   memset(&message, 0, sizeof(message));
175:   message.header = IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION;
176:   message.payload_address = BK7258_IPC_TX_ADDRESS;
177:   message.payload_length = sizeof(*payload);
178:   g_heartbeat_result = -EINPROGRESS;
179:   g_heartbeat_pending = true;
180:   ret = bk7258_mailbox_send_wire(BK7258_MB_CHAN_HW_CTRL_TX, &message,
181:                                  ipc_heartbeat_complete, NULL);
182:   if (ret == OK)
183:     {
184:       g_heartbeat_submissions++;
185:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL;
186:       if (g_heartbeat_submissions <= 3u)
187:         {
188:           printf("IPC: heartbeat queued count=%lu tick=%llu\n",
189:                  (unsigned long)g_heartbeat_submissions,
190:                  (unsigned long long)now);
191:         }
192:     }
193:   else
194:     {
195:       g_heartbeat_pending = false;
196:       g_heartbeat_result = ret;
197:       g_next_heartbeat = now + IPC_HEARTBEAT_RETRY;
198:     }
199: }
200: 
201: int bk7258_ipc_heartbeat_start(void)
202: {
203:   int pid;
204:   int ret;
205: 
206:   if (g_ipc_started)
207:     {
208:       return g_ipc_start_result;
209:     }
210: 
211:   g_ipc_start_result = -EINPROGRESS;
212:   g_heartbeat_enabled = false;
213:   g_heartbeat_pending = false;
214:   g_heartbeat_completions = 0;
215:   g_heartbeat_failures = 0;
216:   g_heartbeat_submissions = 0;
217:   g_heartbeat_reported = 0;
218:   ret = ipc_send(IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION, 0);
219:   g_ipc_start_result = ret < 0 ? ret : OK;
220: 
221:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
222:     {
223:       pid = kthread_create("ipc-heartbeat", IPC_HEARTBEAT_PRIORITY, 1536,
224:                            ipc_heartbeat_worker, NULL);
225:       if (pid < 0)
226:         {
227:           g_ipc_start_result = pid;
228:         }
229:     }
230: 
231:   g_ipc_started = g_ipc_start_result == OK;
232: 
233:   if (g_ipc_start_result == OK)
234:     {
235:       printf("IPC: HW_CTRL power-up acknowledged by CP, heartbeat armed "
236:              "now=%llu deadline=%llu\n",
237:              (unsigned long long)clock_systime_ticks(),
238:              (unsigned long long)g_next_heartbeat);
239:     }
240: 
241:   return g_ipc_start_result;
242: }

1: /****************************************************************************
2:  * BK7258 MBOX0 v2 physical transport.
3:  ****************************************************************************/
4: 
5: #include <nuttx/config.h>
6: 
7: #include <errno.h>
8: #include <stdbool.h>
9: #include <stdint.h>
10: #include <string.h>
11: 
12: #include <nuttx/arch.h>
13: #include <nuttx/irq.h>
14: 
15: #include "arm_internal.h"
16: #include "hardware/bk7258_mbox.h"
17: #include "hardware/bk7258_sysctrl.h"
18: #include "irq.h"
19: 
20: #define MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT      (2u * 3u + 1u)
21: #define MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET   8u
22: 
23: struct mbox_rx_descriptor
24: {
25:   struct bk7258_mb_wire_message message;
26:   uint32_t order;
27:   bool used;
28: };
29: 
30: static bk7258_mbox_callback_t g_callback;
31: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor g_rx_desc[MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT];
32: static uint32_t g_rx_order;
33: static uint32_t g_processing_order;
34: static bool g_mbox_ready;
35: static struct bk7258_mbox_stats g_stats;
36: 
37: _Static_assert(MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT > 2u * 3u,
38:                "RX descriptors must hold a deferred command and two FIFOs");
39: 
40: uint32_t bk7258_mbox_rx_status(void)
41: {
42:   return getreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS);
43: }
44: 
45: static void mbox_clear_errors(void)
46: {
47:   uint32_t config = getreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
48:   uint32_t errors = config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_ERROR_STATUS;
49: 
50:   if ((errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_STATUS) != 0)
51:     {
52:       g_stats.write_error++;
53:     }
54: 
55:   if ((errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_STATUS) != 0)
56:     {
57:       g_stats.read_error++;
58:     }
59: 
60:   if ((errors & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_STATUS) != 0)
61:     {
62:       g_stats.write_full++;
63:     }
64: 
65:   if (errors != 0)
66:     {
67:       putreg32((config & BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RW_MASK) | errors,
68:                BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
69:     }
70: }
71: 
72: static bool mbox_valid_envelope(uint8_t source, uint32_t address,
73:                                 uint32_t length)
74: {
75:   if (source != 0)
76:     {
77:       g_stats.bad_source++;
78:       return false;
79:     }
80: 
81:   if (length != BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
82:     {
83:       g_stats.bad_length++;
84:       return false;
85:     }
86: 
87:   if ((address & 3u) != 0 || address < BK7258_CP_RAM_START ||
88:       address > BK7258_CP_RAM_END - BK7258_MB_MESSAGE_SIZE)
89:     {
90:       g_stats.bad_address++;
91:       return false;
92:     }
93: 
94:   return true;
95: }
96: 
97: int bk7258_mbox_send(uint8_t destination, const uint32_t data[2])
98: {
99:   irqstate_t flags;
100:   uintptr_t status;
101: 
102:   if (!g_mbox_ready || destination > 1 || data == NULL)
103:     {
104:       return -EINVAL;
105:     }
106: 
107:   /* CPU1 transmits through channel 1.  Full is reported by the target's
108:    * receive FIFO status register.
109:    */
110: 
111:   status = destination == 0 ? BK7258_MBOX_CH0_STATUS :
112:                               BK7258_MBOX_CH1_STATUS;
113:   flags = up_irq_save();
114:   if ((getreg32(status) & 1u) != 0)
115:     {
116:       up_irq_restore(flags);
117:       return -EAGAIN;
118:     }
119: 
120:   /* TDATA0/TDATA1 are staging registers and TID commits the descriptor.
121:    * Keep concurrent transport sends from interleaving these writes.
122:    */
123: 
124:   putreg32(data[0], BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA0);
125:   putreg32(data[1], BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TDATA1);
126:   putreg32(destination, BK7258_MBOX_CH1_TID);
127:   up_irq_restore(flags);
128:   return OK;
129: }
130: 
131: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_alloc_desc(void)
132: {
133:   unsigned int i;
134: 
135:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
136:     {
137:       if (!g_rx_desc[i].used)
138:         {
139:           return &g_rx_desc[i];
140:         }
141:     }
142: 
143:   return NULL;
144: }
145: 
146: static bool mbox_priority_message(
147:   const struct bk7258_mb_wire_message *message)
148: {
149:   uint8_t control = bk7258_mb_header_ctrl(message);
150: 
151:   return (control & (BK7258_MB_CTRL_ACK_BOX | BK7258_MB_CTRL_RESET)) != 0;
152: }
153: 
154: static struct mbox_rx_descriptor *mbox_oldest_desc(bool priority)
155: {
156:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *oldest = NULL;
157:   unsigned int i;
158: 
159:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
160:     {
161:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc = &g_rx_desc[i];
162: 
163:       if (!desc->used || mbox_priority_message(&desc->message) != priority)
164:         {
165:           continue;
166:         }
167: 
168:       if (oldest == NULL || (int32_t)(desc->order - oldest->order) < 0)
169:         {
170:           oldest = desc;
171:         }
172:     }
173: 
174:   return oldest;
175: }
176: 
177: static void mbox_process_desc(void)
178: {
179:   struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
180:   int ret;
181: 
182:   /* ACK and RESET never need ACK slots.  Process them ahead of a deferred
183:    * ordinary command, then retry ordinary commands in original FIFO order.
184:    */
185: 
186:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(true)) != NULL)
187:     {
188:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
189:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
190:       g_processing_order = 0;
191:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
192:         {
193:           g_stats.descriptor_deferred++;
194:           break;
195:         }
196: 
197:       desc->used = false;
198:     }
199: 
200:   while ((desc = mbox_oldest_desc(false)) != NULL)
201:     {
202:       g_processing_order = desc->order;
203:       ret = g_callback == NULL ? -ENOSYS : g_callback(&desc->message);
204:       g_processing_order = 0;
205:       if (ret == -EAGAIN)
206:         {
207:           break;
208:         }
209: 
210:       desc->used = false;
211:     }
212: }
213: 
214: static int bk7258_mbox_irq(int irq, void *context, void *arg)
215: {
216:   uintptr_t rdata0;
217:   uintptr_t rdata1;
218:   uintptr_t sidreg;
219:   unsigned int budget = MBOX_IRQ_DRAIN_BUDGET;
220: 
221:   (void)irq;
222:   (void)context;
223:   (void)arg;
224: 
225:   mbox_clear_errors();
226:   sidreg = BK7258_MBOX_CH1_SID;
227:   rdata0 = BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA0;
228:   rdata1 = BK7258_MBOX_CH1_RDATA1;
229: 
230:   while ((bk7258_mbox_rx_status() & 2u) == 0 && budget-- != 0)
231:     {
232:       struct mbox_rx_descriptor *desc;
233:       uint32_t address;
234:       uint32_t length;
235:       uint8_t source;
236: 
237:       mbox_process_desc();
238: 
239:       desc = mbox_alloc_desc();
240:       if (desc == NULL)
241:         {
242:           g_stats.descriptor_full++;
243:           break;
244:         }
245: 
246:       source = getreg32(sidreg) & 0x0fu;
247:       address = getreg32(rdata0);
248:       length = getreg32(rdata1);
249:       if (!mbox_valid_envelope(source, address, length))
250:         {
251:           continue;
252:         }
253: 
254:       __asm__ volatile("dmb sy" ::: "memory");
255:       memcpy(&desc->message, (const void *)(uintptr_t)address,
256:              sizeof(desc->message));
257:       desc->order = ++g_rx_order;
258:       desc->used = true;
259:       g_stats.rx_messages++;
260:       mbox_process_desc();
261:     }
262: 
263:   mbox_process_desc();
264: 
265:   return OK;
266: }
267: 
268: void bk7258_mbox_set_callback(bk7258_mbox_callback_t callback)
269: {
270:   g_callback = callback;
271: }
272: 
273: void bk7258_mbox_kick_rx(void)
274: {
275:   irqstate_t flags = up_irq_save();
276: 
277:   (void)bk7258_mbox_irq(0, NULL, NULL);
278:   up_irq_restore(flags);
279: }
280: 
281: void bk7258_mbox_discard_deferred(void)
282: {
283:   unsigned int i;
284: 
285:   for (i = 0; i < MBOX_RX_DESC_COUNT; i++)
286:     {
287:       if (g_rx_desc[i].used && g_processing_order != 0 &&
288:           (int32_t)(g_rx_desc[i].order - g_processing_order) < 0 &&
289:           !mbox_priority_message(&g_rx_desc[i].message))
290:         {
291:           g_rx_desc[i].used = false;
292:         }
293:     }
294: }
295: 
296: void bk7258_mbox_get_stats(struct bk7258_mbox_stats *stats)
297: {
298:   irqstate_t flags;
299: 
300:   if (stats == NULL)
301:     {
302:       return;
303:     }
304: 
305:   flags = up_irq_save();
306:   *stats = g_stats;
307:   up_irq_restore(flags);
308: }
309: 
310: int bk7258_mbox_init(void)
311: {
312:   int ret;
313: 
314:   if (g_mbox_ready)
315:     {
316:       return OK;
317:     }
318: 
319:   memset(g_rx_desc, 0, sizeof(g_rx_desc));
320:   g_rx_order = 0;
321:   g_processing_order = 0;
322:   memset(&g_stats, 0, sizeof(g_stats));
323: 
324:   /* CPU1 owns channel 1 and FIFO entries 2..4.  Install the callback and
325:    * descriptors before enabling the route; pre-existing FIFO entries are
326:    * then processed normally instead of being blindly discarded.
327:    */
328: 
329:   putreg32(2u | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_INT_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRERR_EN |
330:             BK7258_MBOX_CFG_RDERR_EN | BK7258_MBOX_CFG_WRFULL_EN,
331:             BK7258_MBOX_CH1_CFG);
332:   putreg32(1u | (3u << 1), BK7258_MBOX_CH1_FIFO_CFG);
333:   modifyreg32(BK7258_MBOX_CTRL, 0, 1u << 2);
334:   mbox_clear_errors();
335: 
336:   ret = irq_attach(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX, bk7258_mbox_irq, NULL);
337:   if (ret < 0)
338:     {
339:       return ret;
340:     }
341: 
342:   g_mbox_ready = true;
343:   modifyreg32(BK7258_CPU1_IRQ_EN1, 0, 1u << 31);
344:   up_enable_irq(BK7258_IRQ_MAILBOX);
345:   return OK;
346: }

32:  * forcibly recover it. Normal mailbox round-trips are << 1 ms, so 200 ms
33:  * is well clear of any legitimate burst while still keeping the system
34:  * responsive in the unlikely event the peer never replies. */

52: 	 * CHNL_STATE_BUSY. Used by mb_chnl_write() to detect a physical
53: 	 * channel that has been BUSY abnormally long (peer lost / dropped
54: 	 * the ACK) and forcibly clear it. 0 means "channel is IDLE". */
55: 	volatile u32	busy_since_ms;

211: static volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt = 0;

215: static inline bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send_safe(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src, mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
216: {
217: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
218: 
219: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
220: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(data, src, dst, arg);
221: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
222: 
223: 	return ret_code;
224: }

226: static bool mb_chnl_rx_ready(void)
227: {
228: 	/* Keep one ACK slot available for the command currently being handled.
229: 	 * A command must not be consumed and its business callback run if its
230: 	 * transport ACK cannot be queued. */
231: 	return ack_count < MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1;
232: }
233: 
234: static void mb_chnl_ack_retry(void)
235: {
236: 	u16 chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
237: 
238: 	while (1)
239: 	{
240: 		mb_ack_entry_t entry;
241: 		bk_err_t ret;
242: 		u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
243: 
244: 		if (!ack_count || ack_sending)
245: 		{
246: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
247: 			return;
248: 		}
249: 		entry = ack_queue[ack_read];
250: 		ack_sending = 1;
251: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
252: 
253: 		ret = bk_mailbox_send_safe(&entry.data, SELF_CPU,
254: 			(mailbox_endpoint_t)entry.destination, &chnl_type);
255: 		flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
256: 		if (ret != BK_OK)
257: 		{
258: 			phy_chnl_x_cb[entry.destination].ack_retry_cnt++;
259: 			ack_sending = 0;
260: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
261: 			return;
262: 		}
263: 		ack_read = (ack_read + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
264: 		ack_count--;
265: 		ack_sending = 0;
266: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
267: 		s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
268: 		mb_chnl_notify((mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[entry.destination],
269: 			phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[entry.destination],
270: 			MB_CHNL_EVENT_RX_ACK_SENT);
271: 	}
272: }

274: static bool mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(u8 destination, const mailbox_data_t *data)
275: {
276: 	u32 flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
277: 	mb_ack_entry_t *entry;
278: 
279: 	if (ack_count >= MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN - 1)
280: 	{
281: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[destination].ack_queue_full_cnt++;
282: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
283: 		return false;
284: 	}
285: 	entry = &ack_queue[ack_write];
286: 	entry->data = *data;
287: 	entry->destination = destination;
288: 	ack_write = (ack_write + 1) % MB_ACK_QUEUE_LEN;
289: 	ack_count++;
290: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(flags);
291: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
292: 	return true;
293: }

338: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
339: {
340: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
341: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
342: 	u16 			chnl_type;
343: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
344: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
345: 
346: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
347: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
348: 
349: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
350: 	/* for SMP project, log_chnl is always built by CPU0. it is always failed when call this API in CPU1. */
351: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
352: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
353: #endif
354: 
355: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
356: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
357: 
358: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
359: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
360: 
361: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
362: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
363: 
364: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
365: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
366: 
367: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
368: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
369: 
370: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
371: 
372: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
373: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
374: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
375: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
376: 
377: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
378: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_cmd_header = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
379: 
380: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param1 = cmd_ptr->param1;
381: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param2 = cmd_ptr->param2;
382: 	phy_chnl_ptr->param3 = cmd_ptr->param3;
383: 
384: 	__DMB();
385: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
386: 
387: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
388: 
389: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
390: 
391: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
394: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
395: 
396: 		return ret_code;
397: 	}
398: 
399: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
400: 
401: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
402: 
403: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
404: 	{
405: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
406: 	}
407: 
408: 	return BK_OK;
409: }

411: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
412: {
413: 	u8		log_chnl;
414: 	u8		ret_code;
415: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
416: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
417: 
418: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
419: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
420: 
421: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
422: 	if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_RESET)
423: 	{
424: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
425: 
426: 		phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);
427: 		if (ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != (CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX | CHNL_CTRL_RESET) ||
428: 			ack_ptr->hdr.state != 0 || ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != 0 ||
429: 			ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != 0 || ack_ptr->data1 != 0 ||
430: 			ack_ptr->data2 != 0 || ack_ptr->data3 != 0 ||
431: 			GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl) != SELF_CPU ||
432: 			phy_chnl_idx == SELF_CPU || phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
433: 		{
434: 			s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x10;
435: 			if (phy_chnl_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM)
436: 				phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx].reset_bad_cnt++;
437: 			return;
438: 		}
439: 
440: 		phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
441: 		phy_chnl_ptr->recovering = 1;
442: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx];
443: 		mb_chnl_notify(log_chnl_cb_x,
444: 				   phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx],
445: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_PEER_RESET);
446: 		u32 reset_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
447: 		if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY)
448: 		{
449: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
450: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
451: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
452: 			log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl);
453: 			if (log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx] &&
454: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
455: 			{
456: 				memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
457: 				failure.hdr.cmd = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd;
458: 				failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
459: 				log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(
460: 					log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, &failure);
461: 			}
462: 			bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
463: 		}
464: 		else
465: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(reset_flags);
466: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(log_chnl_cb_x,
467: 				     phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]);
468: 		return;
469: 	}
470: 
471: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
472: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
473: 
474: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
475: 
476: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl)) {
477: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x1;
478: 		return;
479: 	}
480: 
481: 
482: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
483: 	{
484: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x2;
485: 		return;
486: 	}
487: 
488: 
489: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM){
490: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x4;
491: 		return;
492: 	}
493: 
494: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
495: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_header = ack_ptr->hdr.data;
496: 	phy_chnl_ptr->last_ack_data1 = ack_ptr->data1;
497: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
498: 
499: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
500: 	{
501: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x8;
502: 		return;
503: 	}
504: 
505: 	u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
506: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY ||
507: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl != CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX) ||
508: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.state & ~CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) ||
509: 		 (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
510: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) ||
511: 		 (ack_ptr->hdr.cmd != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd))
512: 	{
513: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
514: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
515: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
516: 		return;
517: 	}
518: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
519: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
520: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
521: 
522: 	bk_mailbox_tx_complete((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_chnl_idx);
523: 
524: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
525: 	{
526: 		/* clear following header members. */
527: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
528: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
529: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
530: 
531: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
532: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
533: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
534: 	} else {
535: 		s_mailbox_tx_ack_fault_mask |= 0x100;
536: 	}
537: 
538: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
539: 	if (phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
540: 	{
541: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
542: 		return;
543: 	}
544: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
545: 	{
546: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
547: 			break;
548: 	}
549: 
550: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
551: 	{
552: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
553: 		return;
554: 	}
555: 
556: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
557: 
558: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
559: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
560: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
561: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
562: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
563: 
564: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
565: 
566: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
567: 	{
568: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
569: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
570: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
571: 	}
572: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
573: 
574: 	return;
575: 
576: }

578: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
579: {
580: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
581: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
582: 
583: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
584: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
585: 
586: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
587: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
588: 
589: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
590: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
591: 
592: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
593: 
594: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
595: 		return;
596: 
597: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
598: 		return;
599: 
600: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
601: 		return;
602: 
603: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
604: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
605: 
606: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
607: 
608: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
609: 	{
610: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
611: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
612: 
613: 		return;
614: 	}
615: 
616: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr != NULL)
617: 	{
618: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
619: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
620: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
621: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
622: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
623: 
624: 		if (log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_status_isr(
625: 			log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param,
626: 			(mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr) != BK_OK)
627: 			chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
628: 	}
629: 	else if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
630: 	{
631: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
632: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
633: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
634: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
635: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
636: 
637: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
638: 
639: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
640: 	}
641: 	else
642: 	{
643: 		memset(cmd_ptr, 0, sizeof(*cmd_ptr));
644: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.data = chnl_hdr.data;
645: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
649: 	{
650: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
651: 		return;
652: 	}
653: 
654: 	/* RE-USE the copied command buffer to construct the stable ACK. */
655: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
656: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
657: 
658: 	if (!mb_chnl_ack_enqueue(phy_chnl_idx, (mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr))
659: 	{
660: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
661: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
662: 		return;
663: 	}
664: 	return;
665: }

667: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
668: {
669: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
670: 
671: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
672: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
673: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
674: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
675: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
676: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
677: 
678: 	/*
679: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
680: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
681: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
682: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
683: 	 */
684: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
685: 	{
686: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_ack);
687: 	}
688: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
689: 	{
690: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
691: 	}
692: }

694: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
695: {
696: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
697: 
698: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
699: 
700: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
701: 
702: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
703: 
704: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
705: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
706: 
707: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
708: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
709: 
710: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
711: 
712: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
713: 	{
714: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
715: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
716: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
717: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
718: 
719: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
720: 
721: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
722: 		{
723: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
724: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
725: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
726: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
727: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
728: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
729: 
730: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
731: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
732: 			}
733: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
734: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
735: 			return ret_code;

742: volatile uint32_t s_mailbox_sync_cnt = 0;
743: 
744: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
745: {
746: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
747: 	u16 			chnl_type;
748: 
749: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
750: 
751: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
752: 
753: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
754: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
755: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
756: #endif
757: 
758: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
759: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
760: 
761: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
762: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
763: 
764: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
765: 
766: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
767: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
768: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
769: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
770: 
771: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
772: 
773: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
774: 
775: 	/*
776: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
777: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
778: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
779: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
780: 	 */
781: 	while(1)
782: 	{
783: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
784: 
785: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
786: 		{
787: 			break;
788: 		}
789: 	}
790: 
791: 	return ret_code;
792: }

795: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
796: /*
797:   * init logical chnanel module.
798:   * return:
799:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
800:   *     failed  : fail code.
801:   *
802:   */
803: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
804: {
805: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
806: 	int				i, j;
807: 
808: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
809: 
810: 	/*
811: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
812: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
813: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
814: 	 * can race here:
815: 	 *
816: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
817: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
818: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
819: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
820: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
821: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
822: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
823: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
824: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
825: 	 *
826: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
827: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
828: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
829: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
830: 	 */
831: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
832: 	{
833: 		return BK_OK;
834: 	}
835: 
836: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
837: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
838: 	{
839: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
840: 		return BK_OK;
841: 	}
842: 
843: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
844: 	memset(ack_queue, 0, sizeof(ack_queue));
845: 	ack_read = 0;
846: 	ack_write = 0;
847: 	ack_count = 0;
848: 	ack_sending = 0;
849: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
850: 	{
851: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
852: 
853: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
854: 
855: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
856: 
857: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
858: 		{
859: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
860: 		}
861: 	}
862: 
863: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
864: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
865: 	{
866: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
867: 		return ret_code;
868: 	}
869: 
870: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
871: 
872: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
873: 	{
874: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
875: 
876: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
880: 	bk_mailbox_rx_ready_callback_register(mb_chnl_rx_ready);
881: 
882: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
883: 
884: 	return BK_OK;
885: }

999: /*
1000:   * write to logical chnanel.
1001:   * input:
1002:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
1003:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
1004:   * return:
1005:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
1006:   *     failed  : fail code.
1007:   *
1008:   */
1009: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
1010: {
1011: 	u16		write_len;
1012: 
1013: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
1014: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
1015: 
1016: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
1017: 
1018: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
1019: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
1020: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1021: #endif
1022: 
1023: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
1024: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1025: 
1026: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
1027: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1028: 
1029: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
1030: 
1031: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
1032: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1033: 
1034: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
1035: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
1036: 
1037: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1038: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
1039: 	mb_chnl_cmd_t *logical_cmd = cmd_buf;
1040: 
1041: 	if (phy->recovering &&
1042: 		!(log_chnl == MB_CHNL_UART0 &&
1043: 		  logical_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_UART_STATE_COMMAND))
1044: 	{
1045: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1046: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1047: 	}
1048: 
1049: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
1050: 	{
1051: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1052: 
1053: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
1054: 	}
1055: 
1056: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
1057: 
1058: 	memset(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, 0,
1059: 	       sizeof(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff));
1060: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
1061: 
1062: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
1063: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
1064: 	__DMB();
1065: 
1066: 	bk_err_t start_ret = mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
1067: 
1068: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
1069: 
1070: 	return start_ret;
1071: }

1158: void mb_chnl_poll(void)
1159: {
1160: 	u8 phy_idx;
1161: 	u32 poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1162: 
1163: 	/* The CPU1 boot transaction may poll directly while ap_console is also
1164: 	 * scheduled.  Serialize the whole poll pass without holding the channel
1165: 	 * lock across callbacks and physical sends.
1166: 	 */
1167: 	if (s_poll_active)
1168: 	{
1169: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1170: 		return;
1171: 	}
1172: 	s_poll_active = 1;
1173: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1174: 
1175: 	bk_mailbox_poll();
1176: 	mb_chnl_ack_retry();
1177: 
1178: 	for (phy_idx = 0; phy_idx < PHY_CHNL_NUM; phy_idx++)
1179: 	{
1180: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_idx];
1181: 		mb_log_chnl_cb_t *logs;
1182: 		mb_chnl_ack_t failure;
1183: 		u8 log_idx;
1184: 
1185: 		u32 claim_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1186: 		if ((phy->tx_state != CHNL_STATE_BUSY) || !phy->busy_since_ms ||
1187: 			((u32)(rtos_get_time() - phy->busy_since_ms) < MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS))
1188: 		{
1189: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1190: 			continue;
1191: 		}
1192: 		phy->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
1193: 		phy->busy_since_ms = 0;
1194: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(claim_flags);
1195: 
1196: 		logs = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_idx];
1197: 		log_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(phy->tx_log_chnl);
1198: 		if (log_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx])
1199: 			continue;
1200: 
1201: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt++;
1202: 		phy->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;
1203: 		bk_mailbox_tx_timeout((mailbox_endpoint_t)phy_idx);
1204: 		phy->recovering = 1;
1205: 		memset(&failure, 0, sizeof(failure));
1206: 		failure.hdr.cmd = phy->tx_hdr_cmd;
1207: 		failure.hdr.state = CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;
1208: 		if (logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr)
1209: 			logs[log_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(logs[log_idx].isr_param, &failure);
1210: 		mb_chnl_fail_pending(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx]);
1211: 		mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1212: 				   MB_CHNL_EVENT_TX_TIMEOUT);
1213: 		if (mb_phy_chnl_send_reset(phy_idx, phy->tx_log_chnl) == BK_OK)
1214: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1215: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_SENT);
1216: 		else
1217: 			mb_chnl_notify(logs, phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_idx],
1218: 					   MB_CHNL_EVENT_ABORT_FAILED);
1219: 	}
1220: 
1221: 	poll_flags = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
1222: 	s_poll_active = 0;
1223: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(poll_flags);
1224: }

1226: bk_err_t mb_chnl_get_diag(u8 peer_cpu, mb_chnl_diag_t *diag)
1227: {
1228: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy;
1229: 
1230: 	if (!diag)
1231: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
1232: 	if (peer_cpu >= PHY_CHNL_NUM || peer_cpu == SELF_CPU)
1233: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
1234: 
1235: 	phy = &phy_chnl_x_cb[peer_cpu];

194: static u8 mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(u8 log_chnl)
195: {
196: 	mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t	* cmd_ptr;
197: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
198: 	u16 			chnl_type;
199: 	u8				phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
200: 	u8				log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
201: 
202: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
203: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
204: 
205: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
206: 		return 4;
207: 
208: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
209: 		return 5;
210: 
211: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
212: 		return 3;
213: 
214: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
215: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
216: 
217: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
218: 		return 1;
219: 
220: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq++;
221: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl = log_chnl;
222: 
223: 	cmd_ptr = (mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *)&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff;
224: 
225: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
226: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq;
227: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = 0;
228: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
229: 
230: 	phy_chnl_ptr->tx_hdr_cmd = cmd_ptr->hdr.cmd;
231: 
232: 	__DMB();
233: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
234: 
235: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
236: 
237: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
238: 
239: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
240: 	{
241: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
242: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
243: 
244: 		return 2;
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
248: 
249: 	s_mailbox_tx_cnt++;
250: 
251: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr != NULL)
252: 	{
253: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param);  	/* phy_chnl is BUSY now, tx_isr will not trigger phy_chnl_start_tx. */
254: 	}
255: 
256: 	return 0;
257: }

259: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr(mb_phy_chnl_ack_t *ack_ptr)
260: {
261: 	u8		log_chnl;
262: 	u8		ret_code;
263: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
264: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
265: 
266: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
267: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
268: 
269: 	log_chnl = ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
270: 
271: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
272: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
273: 
274: 	s_mailbox_tx_ack_cnt++;
275: 
276: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
277: 		return;
278: 
279: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
280: 		return;
281: 
282: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
283: 		return;
284: 
285: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
286: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
287: 
288: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
289: 		return;
290: 
291: 	if( (log_chnl != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_log_chnl) ||
292: 		(ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq != phy_chnl_ptr->tx_seq) )
293: 	{
294: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
295: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x40000000;
296: 
297: 		/* Stale / mismatched ACK. The original implementation just
298: 		 * returned here, which left phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state stuck at
299: 		 * BUSY forever and deadlocked all subsequent mb_chnl_write()
300: 		 * on this physical channel. Recover the channel and re-dispatch
301: 		 * any pending logical-channel tx so we don't lose the link. */
302: 		{
303: 			u32 int_mask_stale = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
304: 			u8  i;
305: 
306: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
307: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
308: 
309: 			for (i = 0; i < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; i++) {
310: 				if (log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE) {
311: 					u8 pending = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + i;
312: 					phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;
313: 					phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
314: 					if (mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(pending) != 0) {
315: 						log_chnl_cb_x[i].tx_state   = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
316: 						phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
317: 						phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
318: 					}
319: 					break;
320: 				}
321: 			}
322: 			mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask_stale);
323: 		}
324: 		return;
325: 	}
326: 
327: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr != NULL)
328: 	{
329: 		/* clear following header members. */
330: 		ack_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
331: 		ack_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
332: 		ack_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
333: 
334: 		/* hdr.state, hdr.cmd these 2 members keep untouched. */
335: 
336: 		s_mailbox_tx_compl_cnt++;
337: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_cmpl_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_ack_t *)ack_ptr);
338: 	}
339: 
340: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
341: 	for(log_chnl_idx = 0; log_chnl_idx < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]; log_chnl_idx++)  /* priority descended search. */
342: 	{
343: 		if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
344: 			break;
345: 	}
346: 
347: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
348: 	{
349: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
350: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
351: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
352: 		return;
353: 	}
354: 
355: 	log_chnl = CPX_LOG_CHNL_START(SELF_CPU, phy_chnl_idx) + log_chnl_idx;
356: 
357: 	/* About to dispatch the next pending tx on this physical channel:
358: 	 * refresh the busy-watchdog timestamp so its lifetime starts from
359: 	 * here rather than carrying over from the previous transaction. */
360: 	phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
361: 
362: 	ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
363: 
364: 	if(ret_code != 0)
365: 	{
366: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
367: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state               = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
368: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms          = 0;
369: 	}
370: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
371: 
372: 	return;
373: 
374: }

376: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
377: {
378: 	phy_chnnl_hdr_t  chnl_hdr;
379: 	u8			log_chnl = cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl;
380: 	bk_err_t	ret_code;
381: 	u16 		chnl_type;
382: 
383: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
384: 	u8		log_chnl_idx;
385: 
386: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
387: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
388: 
389: 	s_mailbox_rx_cnt++;
390: 
391: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = SRC_CPU_ID; from SRC_CPU.
392: 	log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
393: 
394: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
395: 		return;
396: 
397: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // received from self.
398: 		return;
399: 
400: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
401: 		return;
402: 
403: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
404: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
405: 
406: 	chnl_hdr.data = cmd_ptr->hdr.data;
407: 
408: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
409: 	{
410: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt++;
411: 		phy_chnl_ptr->rx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
412: 
413: 		return;
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr != NULL)
417: 	{
418: 		/* clear all other hdr members except hdr.cmd. */
419: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = 0;
420: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq       = 0;
421: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl         = 0;
422: 		cmd_ptr->hdr.state        = 0;
423: 
424: 		log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].rx_isr(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)cmd_ptr);
425: 
426: 		/* !!!! cmd_ptr buffer now contains ACK data !!!!. */
427: 	}
428: 	else
429: 	{
430: 		chnl_hdr.state |= CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL;		/* cmd NO target app, it is an ACK bit to peer CPU. */
431: 	}
432: 
433: 	if(chnl_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
434: 	{
435: 		/* sync tx cmd, do NOT send ACK. */
436: 		return;
437: 	}
438: 
439: 	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
440: 
441: 	/* RE-USE the cmd buffer for ACK !!! */
442: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.data  = chnl_hdr.data;
443: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl |= CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX;			/* ACK msg, use the ACK channel.  */
444: 
445: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_ACK_CHNL;
446: 
447: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
448: 
449: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);	/* mb_phy_chnl_tx_ack. */
450: 
451: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
452: 	{
453: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt++;
454: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x80000000;
455: 
456: 		return;
457: 	}
458: 	s_mailbox_rx_ack_cnt++;
459: 	return;
460: }

462: static void mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr(mailbox_data_t * mb_data)
463: {
464: 	mb_phy_chnl_union_t	rx_data;
465: 
466: 	rx_data.mb_data.param0 = mb_data->param0;
467: 	rx_data.mb_data.param1 = mb_data->param1;
468: 	rx_data.mb_data.param2 = mb_data->param2;
469: 	rx_data.mb_data.param3 = mb_data->param3;
470: 	/* the following process will damage the input parameter,
471: 	so pass in the pointer of copied parameter instad of the original. */
472: 
473: 	/*
474: 	 *  there are 2 boxes in one MAILBOXn HW,
475: 	 *  but no way to know which box this msg is from in current mailbox_driver design.
476: 	 *  so use the CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX bit in the msg hdr.ctrl to distinguish where it is from.
477: 	 *  when CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX is set, it means from ack box ( MAILBOXn_BOX1 ).
478: 	 */
479: 	if(rx_data.phy_ch_hdr.ctrl & CHNL_CTRL_ACK_BOX)		/* rx ack. */
480: 	{

482: 	}
483: 	else		/* rx cmd. */
484: 	{
485: 		mb_phy_chnl_rx_cmd_isr(&rx_data.phy_ch_cmd);
486: 	}

489: static void mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(u8 log_chnl)
490: {
491: 	u8		ret_code;
492: 
493: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
494: 
495: 	mb_phy_chnl_cb_t * phy_chnl_ptr;
496: 
497: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
498: 
499: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
500: 		return;
501: 
502: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
503: 		return;
504: 
505: 	phy_chnl_ptr = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
506: 
507: 	if(phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
508: 	{
509: 		phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;		/* MUST set channel state to BUSY firstly. */
510: 		phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = rtos_get_time();
511: 		/* start_tx->tx_cmd->tx_isr callback->mb_chnl_write->start_tx, it is a loop.
512: 		   break the loop by setting the phy_chnl_cb.tx_state to busy. */
513: 
514: 		ret_code = mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd(log_chnl);
515: 
516: 		if(ret_code != 0)
517: 		{
518: 			/* tx_cmd failed before the data hit hardware: roll back BOTH
519: 			 * physical and logical state, so the caller can retry and so
520: 			 * the logical channel does not stay BUSY forever. */
521: 			u8                   log_chnl_idx_fail = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
522: 			mb_log_chnl_cb_t    *log_chnl_cb_x_fail =
523: 				(mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
524: 
525: 			if (log_chnl_idx_fail < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx]) {
526: 				log_chnl_cb_x_fail[log_chnl_idx_fail].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
527: 			}
528: 			phy_chnl_ptr->tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
529: 			phy_chnl_ptr->busy_since_ms = 0;
530: 		}
531: 	}
532: 
533: 	return;
534: }

538: static bk_err_t mb_phy_chnl_tx_cmd_sync(u8 log_chnl, mb_phy_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_ptr)
539: {
540: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
541: 	u16 			chnl_type;
542: 
543: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx;
544: 
545: 	phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
546: 
547: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
548: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
549: 
550: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
551: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
552: 
553: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
554: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
555: 
556: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(phy_chnl_idx);
557: 
558: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.logical_chnl = log_chnl;
559: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.tx_seq = 0;
560: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.ctrl  = CHNL_CTRL_SYNC_TX;
561: 	cmd_ptr->hdr.state = 0;
562: 
563: 	chnl_type = MB_PHY_CMD_CHNL;
564: 
565: 	s_mailbox_sync_cnt++;
566: 
567: 	/*
568: 	 * can't wait 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' to be CHNL_STATE_IDLE here,
569: 	 * 'phy_chnl_cb.tx_state' is set to CHNL_STATE_IDLE in interrupt callback.
570: 	 * but the interrupt may be disabled when this API is called.
571: 	 *    wait physical channel HW to be IDLE by <POLLing> !!
572: 	 */
573: 	while(1)
574: 	{
575: 		ret_code = bk_mailbox_send_safe((mailbox_data_t *)cmd_ptr, SELF_CPU, dst_cpu, (void *)&chnl_type);
576: 
577: 		if(ret_code != BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT)
578: 		{
579: 			break;
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 
583: 	return ret_code;
584: }
