607: /* =====================      logical channel APIs      ==================*/
608: /*
609:   * init logical chnanel module.
610:   * return:
611:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
612:   *     failed  : fail code.
613:   *
614:   */
615: bk_err_t mb_chnl_init(void)
616: {
617: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
618: 	int				i, j;
619: 
620: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
621: 
622: 	/*
623: 	 * mb_chnl_init() is reached from mb_chnl_open(), which is called by
624: 	 * many subsystems (shell log forwarding, ipc_init, mb_uart, ...).
625: 	 * Each one of those callers runs on its own FreeRTOS task and they
626: 	 * can race here:
627: 	 *
628: 	 *   Task A: enters mb_chnl_open(MB_CHNL_LOG), sees mb_chnnl_init_ok==0,
629: 	 *           enters mb_chnl_init(), runs all the memset's, sets
630: 	 *           mb_chnnl_init_ok=1, returns. Caller then sets
631: 	 *           log_chnl_cb2[15].in_used=1 and installs rx_isr.
632: 	 *   Task B (preempted in the middle of mb_chnl_open before the
633: 	 *           init_ok check finishes): comes back, sees init_ok still
634: 	 *           == 0 (because it sampled before A set it), enters
635: 	 *           mb_chnl_init() AGAIN, and the memset wipes the
636: 	 *           log_chnl_cb_x[] array that A just populated.
637: 	 *
638: 	 * Fix: serialize the body with the existing critical section so the
639: 	 * "if (init_ok) return; ... init_ok = 1;" sequence is atomic w.r.t.
640: 	 * other tasks. The double-check pattern still keeps the fast path
641: 	 * lock-free once init has completed.
642: 	 */
643: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
644: 	{
645: 		return BK_OK;
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	uint32_t init_int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
649: 	if(mb_chnnl_init_ok)
650: 	{
651: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
652: 		return BK_OK;
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	memset(&phy_chnl_x_cb, 0, sizeof(phy_chnl_x_cb));
656: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
657: 	{
658: 		phy_chnl_x_cb[i].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
659: 
660: 		log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[i]);
661: 
662: 		memset(log_chnl_cb_x, 0, sizeof(mb_log_chnl_cb_t) * phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]);
663: 
664: 		for(j = 0; j < phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[i]; j++)
665: 		{
666: 			log_chnl_cb_x[j].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
667: 		}
668: 	}
669: 
670: 	ret_code = bk_mailbox_init();
671: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
672: 	{
673: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
674: 		return ret_code;
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	mailbox_endpoint_t    dst_cpu;
678: 
679: 	for(i = 0; i < PHY_CHNL_NUM; i++)
680: 	{
681: 		dst_cpu = (mailbox_endpoint_t)(i);  // dst_cpu_id;
682: 
683: 		bk_mailbox_recv_callback_register(dst_cpu, SELF_CPU, mb_phy_chnl_rx_isr);
684: 	}
685: 
686: 	mb_phy_chnl_reset(0);
687: 
688: 	mb_chnnl_init_ok = 1;
689: 
690: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(init_int_mask);
691: 
692: 	return BK_OK;
693: }

696:   * open logical chnanel.
697:   * input:
698:   *     log_chnl  : logical channel id to open.
699:   *     callback_param : param passsed to all callbacks.

705: bk_err_t mb_chnl_open(u8 log_chnl, void * callback_param)

712: 
713: 		if(ret_code != BK_OK)
714: 		{
715: 			return ret_code;
716: 		}
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
720: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
721: 
722: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
723: 
724: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
725: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
726:

728: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;

730: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
731: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
732: 
733: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
734: 
735: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])

738: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used)
739: 		return BK_ERR_OPEN;

742: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].isr_param = callback_param;
743: 
744: 	return BK_OK;
745: }

801: /*
802:   * write to logical chnanel.
803:   * input:
804:   *     log_chnl     : logical channel id to write.
805:   *     cmd_buf     : buffer of channel cmd data.
806:   * return:
807:   *     succeed: BK_OK;
808:   *     failed  : fail code.
809:   *
810:   */
811: bk_err_t mb_chnl_write(u8 log_chnl, mb_chnl_cmd_t * cmd_buf)
812: {
813: 	u16		write_len;
814: 
815: 	u8		phy_chnl_idx = GET_DST_CPU_ID(log_chnl);   // = DST_CPU_ID;
816: 	u8		log_chnl_idx = GET_LOG_CHNL_ID(log_chnl);
817: 
818: 	mb_log_chnl_cb_t * log_chnl_cb_x;
819: 
820: 	if(SELF_CPU != GET_SRC_CPU_ID(log_chnl))
821: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
822: 
823: 	if(SELF_CPU == phy_chnl_idx)  // transferred to self.
824: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
825: 
826: 	if(phy_chnl_idx >= PHY_CHNL_NUM)
827: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
828: 
829: 	log_chnl_cb_x = (mb_log_chnl_cb_t *)(phy_chnl_log_chnl_list[phy_chnl_idx]);
830: 
831: 	if(log_chnl_idx >= phy_chnl_log_chnl_num[phy_chnl_idx])
832: 		return BK_ERR_PARAM;
833: 
834: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].in_used == 0)
835: 		return BK_ERR_STATE;
836: 
837: 	u32 int_mask = mb_chnl_enter_critical();
838: 
839: 	/* If the physical channel has been BUSY abnormally long (peer never
840: 	 * sent ACK / lost interrupt / lost ack), forcibly recover it so this
841: 	 * and all future mb_chnl_write() calls on the channel don't deadlock. */
842: 	{
843: 		mb_phy_chnl_cb_t *phy_cb_chk = &phy_chnl_x_cb[phy_chnl_idx];
844: 
845: 		if ((phy_cb_chk->tx_state == CHNL_STATE_BUSY) && (phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms != 0))
846: 		{
847: 			u32 now = rtos_get_time();
848: 			u32 age = now - phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms;	/* unsigned wrap is fine for short windows */
849: 
850: 			if (age >= MB_PHY_CHNL_BUSY_TIMEOUT_MS)
851: 			{
852: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt++;
853: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_fault_cnt |= 0x20000000;	/* mark "BUSY-stuck recovered" */
854: 				phy_cb_chk->tx_state      = CHNL_STATE_IDLE;
855: 				phy_cb_chk->busy_since_ms = 0;
856: 			}
857: 		}
858: 	}
859: 
860: 	if(log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state != CHNL_STATE_IDLE)
861: 	{
862: 		mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
863: 
864: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
865: 	}
866: 
867: 	write_len = sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) ? sizeof(mb_chnl_cmd_t) : sizeof(mailbox_data_t);
868: 
869: 	memcpy(&log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].chnnl_tx_buff, cmd_buf, write_len);
870: 
871: 	/* set to BUSY means there is data in tx-buff. mb_phy_chnl_rx_ack_isr will get it to send. */
872: 	log_chnl_cb_x[log_chnl_idx].tx_state = CHNL_STATE_BUSY;   /* MUST set to BUSY after data was copied. */
873: 	__DMB();
874: 
875: 	mb_phy_chnl_start_tx(log_chnl);
876: 
877: 	mb_chnl_exit_critical(int_mask);
878: 
879: 	return BK_OK;
880: }

125: static void ipc_cmd_rx_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
126: {
127: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
128: 	mb_chnl_ack_t * ack_buf = (mb_chnl_ack_t *)cmd_buf;
129: 	ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
130: 
131: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff. MUST be true. */
132: 
133: 	if(cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_FLAG)  /* ipc rsp from other CPU. */
134: 	{
135: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
136: 		{
137: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
138: 		}
139: 
140: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd != (cmd_buf->hdr.cmd & IPC_RSP_CMD_MASK))
141: 		{
142: 			/* un-matched rpc response. */
143: 			goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
144: 		}
145: 
146: 		/* communication ok, function is completed. */
147: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE,
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				__DMB();
168: 
169: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
170: 
171: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
172: 			}
173: 			else
174: 			{
175: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
180: 
181: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
182: 
183: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
185: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
186: 
187: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
188: 
189: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
190: 	}
191: 	else
192: 	{
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
194: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
195: 
196: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
197: 
198: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
199: 		{
200: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
201: 		}
202: 		else
203: 		{
204: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE,
205: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
206: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
207: 			{
208: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
209: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
210: 				#endif
211: 				__DMB();
212: 
213: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 
215: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
216: 			}
217: 			else
218: 			{
219: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
220: 			}
221: 
222: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
223: 		}
224: 
225: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
226: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
227: 	}
228: 
229: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
230: 
231: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
232: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
233: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
234: 	 */
235: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
236: 
237: 	return;
238: 
239: }

241: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
242: {
243: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
244: 	{
245: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
246: 			return;
247: 
248: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
249: 
250: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
251: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
252: 		{
253: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
254: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
255: 
256: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
257: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
258: 		}
259: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
260: 		{
261: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
262: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
263: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
264: 
265: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
266: 
267: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
268: 
269: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
270: 			{
271: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
272: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
273: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
274: 			}
275: 			else
276: 			{
277: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
278: 				{
279: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
280: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
281: 					#endif
282: 					__DMB();
283: 
284: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
285: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
286: 				}
287: 				else
288: 				{
289: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 
293: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
294: 		}
295: 		else
296: 		{
297: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
298: 		}
299: 
300: 		return;
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	/*
304: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
305: 	 */
306: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
307: 
308: 	return;
309: 
310: }

312: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
313: {
314: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
315: 
316: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
317: 		return BK_OK;
318: 
319: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
320: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
321: 
322: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
323: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
324: 
325: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
326: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
327: 	{
328: 		return BK_FAIL;
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
332: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
333: 	{
334: 		return ret_code;
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
338: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
339: 	{
340: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
341: 
342: 		return ret_code;
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
346: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
347: 	{
348: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
349: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
350: 
351: 		return ret_code;
352: 	}
353: 
354: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
355: 
356: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
357: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
358: 
359: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
360: 
361: 	return BK_OK;
362: }

364: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
365: {
366: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
367: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
368: 
369: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
370: 		ipc_init();
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
374: 		return BK_FAIL;
375: 
376: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
377: 
378: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
379: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
380: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
381: 
382: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
383: 
384: 	do
385: 	{
386: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
387: 		{
388: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
389: 			break;
390: 		}
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
393: 			cmd_len = 0;
394: 
395: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
396: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
397: 
398: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
399: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
400: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
401: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
402: 
403: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
404: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
405: 		{
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
410: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
411: 		{
412: 			break;
413: 		}
414: 
415: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
416: 
417: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
430: 		{
431: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
432: 			break;
433: 		}
434: 
435: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
436: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
437: 
438: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
439: 
440: 	}while(0);
441: 
442: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
443: 
444: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
445: 
446: 	return ret_val;
447: 
448: }

515: static u32 ipc_cmd_handler(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)
516: {
517: 	/* must NOT change ack_buf->hdr. */
518: 
519: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 	ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
521: 
522: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
523: 
524: 	ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff;
525: 
526: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)
527: 	{
528: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:
529: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u16))
530: 			{
531: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
532: 
533: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
534: 
535: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
536: 				{
537: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
538: 				}
539: 				else
540: 				{
541: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
542: 				}
543: 			}
544: 			else
545: 			{
546: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
547: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
548: 			}
549: 			break;
550: 
551: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
552: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
553: 			{
554: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
555: 
556: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
557: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
558: 
559: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
560: 
561: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
562: 			}
563: 			else
564: 			{
565: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
566: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
567: 			}
568: 			break;
569: 
570: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:
571: 			{
572: 				// return PS flag to caller.
573: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
574: 
575: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
576: 
577: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);
578: 
579: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
580: 			}
581: 			break;
582: 
583: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
584: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
585: 			{
586: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
587: 				bk_usb_cdc_start();
588: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
589: 			}
590: 			break;
591: 
592: 		case IPC_CPU0_CLOSE_USB_CDC:
593: 			{

148: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
149: 
150: 		BK_LOGD(MOD_TAG, "IPC_RSP_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
151: 
152: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
153: 		{
154: 			/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
155: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
156: 			chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
157: 		}
158: 		else
159: 		{
160: 			/* returns ACK_STATE_COMPLETE,
161: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
162: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
163: 			{
164: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
165: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
166: 				#endif
167: 				__DMB();
168: 
169: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
170: 
171: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
172: 			}
173: 			else
174: 			{
175: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 
179: 		rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
180: 
181: 		ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
182: 
183: 		/* it is a rsp command, nothing need to be returned. */
184: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = NULL;
185: 		ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
186: 
187: 		result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
188: 
189: 		goto ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit;
190: 	}
191: 	else
192: 	{
193: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd = cmd_buf->hdr.cmd;
194: 		chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 1;
195: 
196: 		BK_LOGV(MOD_TAG, "IPC_CMD: %d, %d, %d\r\n", cmd_buf->param1, cmd_buf->param2, cmd_buf->param3);
197: 
198: 		if(ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->cmd_buf))
199: 		{
200: 			result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
201: 		}
202: 		else
203: 		{
204: 			/* may return ACK_STATE_COMPLETE,
205: 			   so must copy data from cmd_buff in case that the buffer is released. */
206: 			if((ipc_cmd->cmd_buff != NULL) && (ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len > 0))
207: 			{
208: 				#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
209: 				flush_dcache(ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
210: 				#endif
211: 				__DMB();
212: 
213: 				memcpy(chnl_cb->cmd_buf, ipc_cmd->cmd_buff, ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len);
214: 
215: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = ipc_cmd->cmd_data_len;
216: 			}
217: 			else
218: 			{
219: 				chnl_cb->cmd_len = 0;
220: 			}
221: 
222: 			result = chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler(chnl_cb, ack_buf);
223: 		}
224: 
225: 		if(result != ACK_STATE_PENDING)
226: 			chnl_cb->rx_cmd_in_process = 0;
227: 	}
228: 
229: ipc_cmd_rx_isr_exit:
230: 
231: 	/* overwrite the cmd_buf after the ISR handle complete.
232: 	 * return the ack info to caller using the SAME buffer with cmd buffer.
233: 	 *     !!!! [input as param / output as result ]  !!!!
234: 	 */
235: 	ack_buf->ack_state = result;
236: 
237: 	return;
238: 
239: }

241: static void ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
242: {
243: 	if(ack_buf->hdr.cmd == chnl_cb->tx_cmd)
244: 	{
245: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process == 0)	/* RSP_CMD rx_isr may arrive before this tx_cmpl_isr. */
246: 			return;
247: 
248: 		/* IPC cmd tx complete. */
249: 
250: 		if( (ack_buf->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
251: 			|| (ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_FAIL) )
252: 		{
253: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
254: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;
255: 
256: 			/* communication failed or function failed. */
257: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
258: 		}
259: 		else if(ack_buf->ack_state == ACK_STATE_COMPLETE)
260: 		{
261: 			/* communication ok, function is completed. */
262: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
263: 			chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
264: 
265: 			ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
266: 
267: 			/* chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
268: 
269: 			if(ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > sizeof(chnl_cb->rsp_buf))
270: 			{
271: 				/* buffer insufficient, failed. */
272: 				chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 1;
273: 				chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
274: 			}
275: 			else
276: 			{
277: 				if((ipc_rsp->rsp_buff != NULL) && (ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len > 0))
278: 				{
279: 					#if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
280: 					flush_dcache(ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
281: 					#endif
282: 					__DMB();
283: 
284: 					memcpy(chnl_cb->rsp_buf, ipc_rsp->rsp_buff, ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len);
285: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len;
286: 				}
287: 				else
288: 				{
289: 					chnl_cb->rsp_len = 0;
290: 				}
291: 			}
292: 
293: 			rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
294: 		}
295: 		else
296: 		{
297: 			/* communication ok, function is pending. */
298: 		}
299: 
300: 		return;
301: 	}
302: 
303: 	/*
304: 	 *   !!!  FAULT  !!!
305: 	 */
306: 	BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fault in %s,cmd:%d\r\n", __func__, ack_buf->hdr.cmd);
307: 
308: 	return;
309: 
310: }

312: static bk_err_t ipc_chnl_init(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 chnl_id, ipc_rx_cmd_hdlr_t rx_handler)
313: {
314: 	bk_err_t		ret_code;
315: 
316: 	if(chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
317: 		return BK_OK;
318: 
319: 	memset(chnl_cb, 0, sizeof(ipc_chnl_cb_t));
320: 	chnl_cb->chnl_id = chnl_id;
321: 
322: 	chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_tx_buff(chnl_id);
323: 	chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff = mb_chnl_get_rx_buff(chnl_id);
324: 
325: 	if( (chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) ||
326: 		(chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff == NULL) )
327: 	{
328: 		return BK_FAIL;
329: 	}
330: 
331: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore_adv(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, 1, 1);
332: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
333: 	{
334: 		return ret_code;
335: 	}
336: 
337: 	ret_code = rtos_init_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, 1);
338: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
339: 	{
340: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
341: 
342: 		return ret_code;
343: 	}
344: 
345: 	ret_code = mb_chnl_open(chnl_id, chnl_cb);
346: 	if(ret_code != BK_OK)
347: 	{
348: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
349: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema);
350: 
351: 		return ret_code;
352: 	}
353: 
354: 	chnl_cb->rx_cmd_handler = rx_handler;
355: 
356: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_RX_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_rx_isr);
357: 	mb_chnl_ctrl(chnl_id, MB_CHNL_SET_TX_CMPL_ISR, (void *)ipc_cmd_tx_cmpl_isr);
358: 
359: 	chnl_cb->chnl_inited = 1;
360: 
361: 	return BK_OK;
362: }

364: static bk_err_t ipc_send_cmd(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, u8 cmd, u8 *cmd_buf, u16 cmd_len, u8 * rsp_buf, u16 rsp_buf_len)
365: {
366: 	bk_err_t	ret_val = BK_FAIL;
367: 	ipc_cmd_t	ipc_cmd;
368: 
369: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited){
370: 		ipc_init();
371: 	}
372: 
373: 	if(!chnl_cb->chnl_inited)
374: 		return BK_FAIL;
375: 
376: 	rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema, BEKEN_WAIT_FOREVER);
377: 
378: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd = cmd;
379: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed = 0;
380: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 1;
381: 
382: 	void * dst_buf = (void *)chnl_cb->tx_xchg_buff;
383: 
384: 	do
385: 	{
386: 		if(cmd_len > IPC_XCHG_DATA_MAX)
387: 		{
388: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
389: 			break;
390: 		}
391: 
392: 		if(cmd_buf == NULL)
393: 			cmd_len = 0;
394: 
395: 		if(cmd_len > 0)
396: 			memcpy(dst_buf, cmd_buf, cmd_len);
397: 
398: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.data = 0;	/* clear hdr. */
399: 		ipc_cmd.chnl_hdr.cmd  = cmd;
400: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_buff      = dst_buf;
401: 		ipc_cmd.cmd_data_len  = cmd_len;
402: 
403: 		ret_val = mb_chnl_write(chnl_cb->chnl_id, (mb_chnl_cmd_t *)&ipc_cmd);
404: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
405: 		{
406: 			break;
407: 		}
408: 
409: 		ret_val = rtos_get_semaphore(&chnl_cb->rsp_sema, IPC_RSP_TIMEOUT);  /* isr_callback will set this semaphore. */
410: 		if(ret_val != BK_OK)
411: 		{
412: 			break;
413: 		}
414: 
415: 		chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process  = 0;  /* must have been set to 0 by callback. */
416: 
417: 		if(chnl_cb->tx_cmd_failed)
418: 		{
419: 			ret_val = BK_FAIL;
420: 			break;
421: 		}
422: 
423: 		if((rsp_buf == NULL) || (rsp_buf_len == 0))
424: 		{
425: 			ret_val = BK_OK;
426: 			break;
427: 		}
428: 
429: 		if(rsp_buf_len < chnl_cb->rsp_len)
430: 		{
431: 			ret_val = BK_ERR_PARAM;
432: 			break;
433: 		}
434: 
435: 		if(chnl_cb->rsp_len > 0)
436: 			memcpy(rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_buf, chnl_cb->rsp_len);
437: 
438: 		ret_val = BK_OK;
439: 
440: 	}while(0);
441: 
442: 	chnl_cb->tx_cmd_in_process = 0;
443: 
444: 	rtos_set_semaphore(&chnl_cb->chnl_sema);
445: 
446: 	return ret_val;
447: 
448: }

515: static u32 ipc_cmd_handler(ipc_chnl_cb_t *chnl_cb, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)
516: {
517: 	/* must NOT change ack_buf->hdr. */
518: 
519: 	u32		result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
520: 	ipc_rsp_t * ipc_rsp = (ipc_rsp_t *)ack_buf;
521: 
522: 	/* chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff == ipc_cmd->cmd_buff == ipc_rsp->rsp_buff. MUST be true. */
523: 
524: 	ipc_rsp->rsp_buff = chnl_cb->rx_xchg_buff;
525: 
526: 	switch(chnl_cb->rx_cmd)
527: 	{
528: 		case IPC_RES_AVAILABLE_INDICATION:
529: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u16))
530: 			{
531: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
532: 
533: 				u16  res_id = *((u16 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf);
534: 
535: 				if(amp_res_available(res_id) == BK_OK)
536: 				{
537: 					result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
538: 				}
539: 				else
540: 				{
541: 					result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
542: 				}
543: 			}
544: 			else
545: 			{
546: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
547: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
548: 			}
549: 			break;
550: 
551: 		case IPC_TEST_CMD:
552: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
553: 			{
554: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
555: 
556: 				u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
557: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
558: 
559: 				*p_dst = (*p_src) + 1;
560: 
561: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
562: 			}
563: 			else
564: 			{
565: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
566: 				result = ACK_STATE_FAIL;
567: 			}
568: 			break;
569: 
570: 		case IPC_GET_POWER_SAVE_FLAG:
571: 			{
572: 				// return PS flag to caller.
573: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = sizeof(u32);
574: 
575: 				u32 * p_dst = (u32 *)ipc_rsp->rsp_buff;
576: 
577: 				mb_ipc_get_power_save_state(p_dst);
578: 
579: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
580: 			}
581: 			break;
582: 
583: #if (USB_CDC_CP1_IPC)
584: 		case IPC_CPU0_START_USB_CDC:
585: 			{
586: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
587: 				bk_usb_cdc_start();
588: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
589: 			}
590: 			break;
591: 
592: 		case IPC_CPU0_CLOSE_USB_CDC:
593: 			{
594: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
595: 				bk_usb_cdc_close();
596: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
597: 			}
598: 			break;
599: 		case IPC_CPU0_STOP_USB_CDC:
600: 			{
601: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
602: 				bk_usb_cdc_stop();
603: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
604: 			}
605: 			break;
606: 
607: 		case IPC_CPU0_INIT_USB_CDC_PARAM:
608: 			{
609: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
610: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
611: 				bk_usb_cdc_init(p_cdc_data);
612: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
613: 			}
614: 			break;
615: 
616: 		case IPC_CPU0_SET_USB_CDC_CMD:
617: 			{
618: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
619: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
620: 				bk_cdc_acm_bulkout(p_cdc_data);
621: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
622: 			}
623: 			break;
624: #endif
625: 
626: #if (USB_CDC_CP0_IPC)
627: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPLOAD_USB_CDC_DATA:
628: 			{
629: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
630: 				IPC_CDC_DATA_t *p_cdc_data = (IPC_CDC_DATA_t *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
631: 				if (p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb) {
632: 					p_cdc_data->bk_cdc_acm_bulkin_cb();
633: 				}
634: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
635: 			}
636: 			break;
637: 		case IPC_CPU1_UPDATE_USB_CDC_STATE:
638: 			{
639: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
640: 				extern void (*usb_cdc_state_cb)(bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status);
641: 				bk_cdc_hub_status * cdc_status = (bk_cdc_hub_status *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
642: 				if (usb_cdc_state_cb) {
643: 					usb_cdc_state_cb(cdc_status);
644: 				}
645: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
646: 			}
647: 			break;
648: #endif
649: 
650: 
651: 		case IPC_CPU1_POWER_UP_INDICATION:		// cpu1 indication, power up successfully.
652: 			{
653: 				/* no params. */
654: 				/* inform modules who care CPU1 state. */
655: 				u8   on_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
656: 				mb_ipc_power_on_notify(on_cpu_id);
657: 				if (on_cpu_id == MAILBOX_CPU1)
658: 					ap_console_bridge_ready_update(AP_BRIDGE_READY_IPC, true);
659: 
660: 				/* no returns. */
661: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
662: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
663: 			}
664: 			break;
665: 
666: 		case IPC_CPU1_HEART_BEAT_INDICATION:	// cpu1 indication, alive indication.
667: 			if(chnl_cb->cmd_len >= sizeof(u32))
668: 			{
669: 				// contains any data?
670: 				// u32 * p_src = (u32 *)chnl_cb->cmd_buf;
671: 
672: 				// save the param.
673: 
674: 				u8   hb_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
675: 				mb_ipc_heartbeat_notify(hb_cpu_id);
676: 
677: 			}
678: 
679: 			/* succeeded anyway but no returns. */
680: 			ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
681: 			result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
682: 			break;
683: 
684: 		case IPC_CPU1_TRAP_HANDLE_BEGIN:		// cpu1 indication, dump begin.
685: 			{
686: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
687: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
688: 
689:                 g_ap_dump_flag = 1;
690: 
691:                 /* if ap dump ,then cp shoule disable its most interruptions */
692:                 sys_drv_int_disable(0xFFFE7FE7);
693:                 sys_drv_int_group2_disable(0x7FFFFFFF);
694: 
695: 				u8   dump_cpu_id = GET_DST_CPU_ID(chnl_cb->chnl_id);
696: 				mb_ipc_dump_notify(dump_cpu_id, 1);
697: 				/* no params, no returns. */
698: 				#if (CONFIG_SHELL_ASYNCLOG)
699: 				shell_set_log_cpu(dump_cpu_id);
700: 				#endif
701: 			}
702: 			break;
703: 
704: 		case IPC_CPU1_TRAP_HANDLE_END:		// cpu1 indication, dump end.
705: 			{
706: 				ipc_rsp->rsp_data_len = 0;
707: 				result = ACK_STATE_COMPLETE;
708: 
709:                 g_ap_dump_flag = 0;
710:

214: u8 cal_crc8_0x31(u8 *data_buf, u16 len)

270: static mb_ipc_route_t * ipc_router_search_route(u8 dst_cpu, u32 * route_id)
271: {
272: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = NULL;
273: 
274: 	for(int i = 0; i < ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl); i++)
275: 	{
276: 		if(ipc_route_tbl[i].dst_cpus & (0x01 << dst_cpu))
277: 		{
278: 			ipc_route = &ipc_route_tbl[i];
279: 			*route_id = i;
280: 			break;
281: 		}
282: 	}
283: 
284: 	return ipc_route;
285: }

287: /*
288:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
289:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
290:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
291:  * 
292:  */
293: static int ipc_router_send(mb_ipc_route_t *ipc_route, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
294: {
295: 	int   queue_cnt; // number of items in the queue.
296: 	int   free_cnt;
297: 
298: 	/* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
299: 	u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
300: 
301: 	if(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx >= ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
302: 	{
303: 		queue_cnt = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
304: 		free_cnt  = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - queue_cnt;
305: 	}
306: 	else
307: 	{
308: 		free_cnt  = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_out_idx - ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
309: 		queue_cnt = ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue) - free_cnt;
310: 	}
311: 	
312: 	if( free_cnt <= 1 )  // reserved one for empty judgement.
313: 	{
314: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
315: 		
316: 		return  IPC_ROUTE_QUEUE_FULL;
317: 	}
318: 	
319: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx;
320: 	
321: 	// memcpy(&ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx], ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
322: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
323: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
324: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
325: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx].mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
326: 	
327: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue);
328: 	ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx = tx_idx;
329: 
330: 	// it is the first item pushed to the queue, then try to send.
331: 	if(queue_cnt == 0)
332: 	{
333: 		mb_chnl_write(ipc_route->log_chnl, &ipc_cmd->mb_cmd);
334: 	}
335: 
336: 	// Put mb_chnl_write inside the critical section to avoid sending the same message twice
337: 	// in multi-core operation scenarios. If another core interrupts here after the queue is updated
338: 	// but before mb_chnl_write is called, two cores might attempt to send the same message simultaneously.
339: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);  /* used to protect ipc_route->chnl_tx_queue_in_idx. */
340: 
341: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
342: }

344: /* 
345:  * it MUST be protected by critical-section.
346:  * it is called by RX-ISR.
347:  */
348: #if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
349: static int ipc_router_fwd(mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
350: {
351: 	u32               route_id;
352: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, &route_id);
353: 
354: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
355: 	{
356: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
357: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
358: 	}
359: 
360: 	// forward this cmd.
361: 	return ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
362: }
363: #endif

365: static void ipc_router_rx_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_cmd_t *cmd_buf)
366: {
367: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)cmd_buf;
368: 
369: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
370: 	/* please refer to <design document> P45 rx_isr 2). */
371: 	// if it is a fwd cmd/rsp.
372: 	if( ipc_cmd->dst_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )  // it is not for me, then forward it.
373: 	{
374: 		BK_ASSERT(CURRENT_CPU == MAILBOX_CPU1); // in current configuration, CPU1 used to forward cmd.
375: 
376: 		ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_router_fwd(ipc_cmd);
377: 
378: 		return;
379: 	}
380: 	#endif
381: 
382: 	// it is for me, process the cmd/rsp.
383: 
384: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd/rsp.
385: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
386: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
387: 
388: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
389: 
390: 	#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
391: 	if(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
392: 	{
393: 		// ipc_socket may be == NULL, don't reference it.
394: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "rx error: cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
395: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
396: 	}
397: 	#endif
398: 
399: 	return;
400: }

402: static void ipc_router_tx_cmpl_isr(void *param, mb_chnl_ack_t *ack_buf)  /* tx_cmpl_isr */
403: {
404: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t     * ipc_cmd = (mb_ipc_cmd_t *)ack_buf;
405: 	u32                route_id = (u32)param;
406: 
407: 	// data sanity check.
408: 	if(route_id >= ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl))
409: 	{
410: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, id=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, route_id);
411: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
412: 	}
413: 
414: 	// data sanity check - protect queue access with critical section
415: 	u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
416: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
417: 	{
418: 		// queue empty.
419: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
420: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, indx=%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
421: 			ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx);
422: 		
423: 		return;   /* something wrong. */
424: 	}
425: 
426: 	u16  tx_idx = ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
427: 	
428: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[tx_idx];
429: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
430: 
431: 	// data sanity check.
432: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
433: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
434: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
435: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
436: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
437: 		#endif
438: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
439: 	{
440: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
441: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
442: 
443: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
444: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
445: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
446: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
447: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
448: 		#endif
449: 
450: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
451: 	}
452: 
453: 	/* remove the first cmd from the queue. */
454: 	temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
455: 	tx_idx = (tx_idx + 1) % ARRAY_SIZE(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue);
456: 	ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx = tx_idx;
457: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
458: 
459: 	#if !CONFIG_SOC_SMP
460: 	// it is a forwarded cmd/rsp.
461: 	if( ipc_cmd->src_cpu != CURRENT_CPU )
462: 	{
463: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
464: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
465: 		{
466: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Fwd failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
467: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
468: 		}
469: 
470: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
471: 	}
472: 	#endif
473: 
474: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket;
475: 	
476: 	// search the ipc_socket by port;
477: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_sender(ipc_cmd->src_port, ipc_cmd->dst_cpu, ipc_cmd->dst_port);
478: 
479: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
480: 	{
481: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx error @%d!, cmd-%02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
482: 			ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
483: 
484: 		goto tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd;
485: 	}
486: 
487: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
488: 
489: tx_cmpl_isr_next_cmd:
490: 
491: 	/* refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3). */
492: 
493: 	// protect queue access with critical section to avoid race condition
494: 	temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
495: 	if(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_in_idx == ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx)
496: 	{
497: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
498: 		return;  // no pending cmd in the queue.
499: 	}
500: 
501: 	// use updated tx_idx (which is the current out_idx after increment)
502: 	u16 next_tx_idx = ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue_out_idx;
503: 	queue_cmd = &ipc_route_tbl[route_id].chnl_tx_queue[next_tx_idx];
504: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
505: 
506: 	// send next pending cmd. // refer to <design document> P45 tx_cmpl_isr 3).
507: 	mb_chnl_write(ipc_route_tbl[route_id].log_chnl, &queue_cmd->mb_cmd);
508: 
509: 	return;
510: 
511: }

520: static mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket_search_sender(u8 src_port, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port)
521: {
522: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = NULL;
523: 	
524: 	if( IS_SERVER_PORT(src_port) )
525: 	{
526: 		int svr_idx = src_port - SERVER_PORT_MIN;
527: 		
528: 		for(int i = 0; i < MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR; i++)
529: 		{
530: 			if(ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i].dst_port != dst_port)
531: 				continue;
532: 			if(ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i].dst_cpu != dst_cpu)
533: 				continue;
534: 
535: 			ipc_socket = &ipc_server_socket_tbl[svr_idx][i];
536: 			
537: 			// data sanity check.
538: 			#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
539: 			if( (ipc_socket->handle.connect_id != i) || 
540: 				(ipc_socket->handle.src_port != src_port) || 
541: 				(ipc_socket->handle.sock_valid == 0) )
542: 			{
543: 				BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__);
544: 			}
545: 			#endif
546: 			
547: 			break;
548: 		}
549: 	}
550: 	else if( IS_CLIENT_PORT(src_port) )
551: 	{
552: 		ipc_socket = &ipc_client_socket_tbl[src_port - CLIENT_PORT_MIN];
553: 
554: 		if( (ipc_socket->dst_cpu != dst_cpu) || (ipc_socket->dst_port != dst_port) )
555: 		{
556: 			return NULL;
557: 		}
558: 
559: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
560: 		// data sanity check.
561: 		if( (ipc_socket->handle.src_port != src_port) || 
562: 			(ipc_socket->handle.sock_valid == 0) )
563: 		{
564: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d!\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__);
565: 		}
566: 		#endif
567: 	}
568: 	else
569: 	{
570: 		// invalid port number.
571: 		return NULL;
572: 	}
573: 
574: 	return ipc_socket;
575: }

703: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
704: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd);
705: 
706: /*
707:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
708:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
709:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
710:  * 
711:  */
712: static int ipc_socket_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
713: {
714: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
715: 	{
716: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
717: 	}
718: 	
719: 	u32               temp;
720: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
721: 
722: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
723: 	{
724: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
725: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
726: 	}
727: 
728: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
729: 	
730: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
731: 
732: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
733: 
734: 	if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
735: 	{
736: 		// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
737: 		mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS);
738: 	}
739: 
740: 	return route_status;
741: }
742: 
743: /*
744:  * because ipc_cmd is a pointer, 
745:  * it may pending in the tx_queue, 
746:  * so the memory ipc_cmd pointed must **NOT** be in stack (temporary memory).
747:  * 
748:  */
749: static int ipc_socket_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd, u32 retry)
750: {
751: 	if(retry == 0)
752: 	{
753: 		ipc_socket->tx_tag++;
754: 	}
755: 	ipc_cmd->tag = ipc_socket->tx_tag;
756: 	
757: 	if(ipc_socket->dst_cpu == ipc_socket->src_cpu)
758: 	{
759: 		return ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
760: 	}
761: 	
762: 	u32               temp;
763: 	mb_ipc_route_t  * ipc_route = ipc_router_search_route(ipc_socket->dst_cpu, &temp);
764: 
765: 	if(ipc_route == NULL)
766: 	{
767: 		// no route for this destination cpu.
768: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
769: 	}
770: 
771: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
772: 
773: 	mb_atomic_set(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
774: 	
775: 	int route_status = ipc_router_send(ipc_route, ipc_cmd);
776: 
777: 	if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
778: 	{
779: 		// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
780: 		mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
781: 	}
782: 
783: 	return route_status;
784: }

808: static void ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t * ipc_cmd)
809: {
810: 	// if it is a rsp.
811: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 1). */
812: 	if( ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG )
813: 	{
814: 		if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
815: 			(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
816: 		{
817: 			BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "Rsp failed, cmd %02x, param1=%08x!\r\n", 
818: 				ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
819: 		}
820: 
821: 		// completed the rx-process, so clear the flag.
822: 		// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
823: 		mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS);
824: 
825: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnect rsp send ok.
826: 		{
827: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
828: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
829: 		}
830: 		
831: 		return;
832: 	}
833: 
834: 	// it is a cmd.
835: 
836: 	// queue_cmd points to the tx_cmd, ipc_cmd must match the current state of tx_cmd.
837: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t * queue_cmd = &ipc_socket->tx_cmd;
838: 
839: 	// data sanity check.
840: 	if( (((queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1 ^ ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1) & IPC_PARAM1_MASK) != 0)
841: 		|| (queue_cmd->hdr.cmd != ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd)
842: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
843: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
844: 		|| (queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
845: 		#endif
846: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
847: 	{
848: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s tx2 error @%d! %x != %x.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
849: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param1, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1);
850: 
851: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
852: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: ipc-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
853: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param2, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2);
854: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "tx2 error: que-cmd-%02x, %x != %x.\r\n", queue_cmd->hdr.cmd, 
855: 			queue_cmd->mb_cmd.param3, ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3);
856: 		#endif
857: 
858: 		return;   /* something wrong. */ /* not the CMD just sent. */
859: 	}
860: 	
861: 	// if send failed.
862: 	/* refer to <design document> P44 tx_cmpl_isr 2). */
863: 	if( (ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL) || 
864: 		(ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK) )
865: 	{
866: 
867: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.state & CHNL_STATE_COM_FAIL)
868: 		{
869: 			// mailbox channel tx failed. 
870: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_FAILED;
871: 		}
872: 		else  // (ipc_cmd->route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
873: 		{
874: 			// router failed.
875: 			ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->route_status;
876: 		}
877: 
878: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
879: 
880: 		return;
881: 	}
882: 
883: }

885: static int ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
886: {
887: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
888: 	{
889: 		// no connection for this rsp.
890: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
891: 	}
892: 
893: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) == 0 )	/* unsolicited ipc response. */
894: 	{
895: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNSOLICITED_RSP;
896: 	}
897: 
898: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
899: 	{
900: 		/* un-matched response. */
901: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
902: 	}
903: 
904: 	if(ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd != (ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd & MB_IPC_CMD_MASK))
905: 	{
906: 		/* un-matched response. */
907: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
908: 	}
909: 
910: 	// data sanity check.
911: 	if( (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag != ipc_cmd->tag)
912: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
913: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2)
914: 		|| (ipc_socket->tx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 != ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3) 
915: 		#endif
916: 		) /* param1, other fields not compared. */
917: 	{
918: 		#if DEBUG_MB_IPC
919: 		BK_LOGE(MOD_TAG, "%s error @%d, %d != %d.\r\n", __FUNCTION__, __LINE__, 
920: 			ipc_socket->tx_cmd.tag, ipc_cmd->tag);
921: 		#endif
922: 
923: 		/* not the response for the CMD just sent. */
924: 		return IPC_ROUTE_UNMATCHED_RSP;
925: 	}
926: 
927: 	#if 0   // can't clear connection here, becasue tx_cmpl_isr will use this connection again.
928: 	        // if there is direct connection between 2 cores, rsp will arrive ahead of cmd-tx_cmpl_isr.
929: 	if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == (MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG | MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD)) // disconnected.
930: 	{
931: 		// it must have been disconnected in the peer side.
932: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
933: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
934: 	}
935: 	#endif
936: 
937: 	/* save cmd return-status, tx is completed. */
938: 	if(ipc_cmd->api_impl_status != IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK)
939: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED + ipc_cmd->api_impl_status;
940: 	else
941: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_TX_OK;
942: 
943: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
944: 
945: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // this status return is worthless but for debug.
946: }

948: static void ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, int error_code)
949: {
950: 	ipc_socket->rx_cmd.api_impl_status = error_code & 0x0F;
951: 
952: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
953: }

955: // connect command handler, it is handled internally.
956: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_connect(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
957: {
958: 	ipc_socket->use_flag  |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
959: 	// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // must have no cmd in sending, clear tx_in_process to be sure. 
960: 	mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
961: 	ipc_socket->tx_status = 0;  // must have no cmd in sending, so clear the tx status too.
962: 
963: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
964: 
965: 	return -1;  // don't notify upper layer for further process.
966: }
967: 
968: // disconnect command handler, it is handled internally.
969: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_disconnect(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
970: {
971: 	if( (ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS) != 0 )
972: 	{
973: 		ipc_socket->tx_status = MB_IPC_DISCONNECTED;
974: 
975: 		/* tx may be failed. disconnect notification. */
976: 		ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_notify(ipc_socket);
977: 	}
978: 
979: 	ipc_socket->use_flag  &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
980: 	// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;    // cleared TX_IN_PROCESS.
981: 	mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
982: 
983: 	ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
984: 
985: 	if(IS_CLIENT_PORT(ipc_socket->src_port))
986: 	{
987: 	//	ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
988: 		return 0;  // need to notify upper layer for further process.
989: 		// if it is a client, notify app to close socket to free resources.
990: 		// server must NOT close socket. it will wait for new connection.
991: 	}
992: 	
993: 	return -1;  // don't notify upper layer for further process.
994: 
995: }

997: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_default_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket)
998: {
999: 	// connect/disconnect commands don't check use_flag_connected & wait_tag.
1000: 	// other commands need these checks.
1001: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED) == 0 )
1002: 	{
1003: 		ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_RX_NOT_CONNECT);
1004: 		
1005: 		return -1;  // need not to notify upper layer.
1006: 	}
1007: 
1008: 	if(ipc_socket->rx_tag == ipc_socket->rx_cmd.tag)
1009: 	{
1010: 		// coomand has processed in previously recv, it is a re-sent cmd.
1011: 		ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->rx_cmd);
1012: 
1013: 		return -1;  // need not to notify upper layer.
1014: 	}
1015: 	
1016: //	ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
1017: 
1018: 	return 0;  // need to notify upper layer for further process.
1019: }

1021: static int ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1022: {
1023: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1024: 	{
1025: 		if(ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd == MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD)  // it is a connect cmd, not includes the connect response.
1026: 		{
1027: 			// try to establish the connection.
1028: 			u32 temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
1029: 			ipc_socket = ipc_socket_server_accept(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1030: 			mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1031: 			if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1032: 			{
1033: 				// no connection for this cmd.
1034: 				return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
1035: 			}
1036: 		}
1037: 		else
1038: 		{
1039: 			// no connection for this cmd.
1040: 			return IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE;
1041: 		}
1042: 	}
1043: 
1044: 	int route_status = IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // return to indicate that cmd has reached target. 
1045: 
1046: 	if( ipc_socket->run_state & STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS )	/* has a cmd uncompleted. */
1047: 	{
1048: 		ipc_cmd->api_impl_status = IPC_API_IMPL_RX_BUSY;
1049: 
1050: 		#if 0
1051: 		// send rsp to fail this cmd.
1052: 		ipc_socket_tx_rsp(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1053: 		      /* can't call ipc_socket_tx_rsp, because ipc_cmd point to stack memory. */
1054: 		#else
1055: 		route_status = IPC_ROUTE_RX_BUSY;
1056: 		     /*             !!! NOTE !!!                     */
1057: 			 /*       no way to report this fail.            */
1058: 		     /* it is a temporary solution to indicate fail. */
1059: 			 /* actually, it is a API layer fail,            */
1060: 			 /* should return fail state in api_impl_status. */
1061: 		#endif
1062: 	}
1063: 	else  /* it is OK to receive the cmd. */
1064: 	{
1065: 		// save the cmd for further processing.
1066: 		// memcpy(&ipc_socket->rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(mb_ipc_cmd_t));
1067: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1068: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1069: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1070: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1071: 		
1072: 		ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1073: 		// ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;
1074: 		mb_atomic_set(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS);
1075: 
1076: 		if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )  // socket must have been initialized.
1077: 		{
1078: 			ipc_socket_rx_cmd_error_handler(ipc_socket, IPC_API_IMPL_NOT_INITED);
1079: 			
1080: 			return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1081: 		}
1082: 
1083: 		ipc_socket->rx_cmd.api_impl_status = IPC_API_IMPL_STATUS_OK;  // clear the status before providing to upper layer.
1084: 
1085: 		int  ret_val = 0;
1086: 		
1087: 		/* rx cmd process. */
1088: 		switch(ipc_socket->rx_cmd.hdr.cmd)
1089: 		{
1090: 			case MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD:
1091: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_connect(ipc_socket);
1092: 				break;
1093: 
1094: 			case MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD:
1095: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_disconnect(ipc_socket);
1096: 				break;
1097: 
1098: 			case MB_IPC_SEND_CMD:
1099: 				// no special process, go through to default handler.
1100: 				// break;
1101: 				
1102: 			default:
1103: 				ret_val = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_default_handler(ipc_socket);
1104: 				break;
1105: 		}
1106: 
1107: 		ipc_socket->rx_tag = ipc_socket->rx_cmd.tag;
1108: 
1109: 		if(ret_val == 0)  // need to notify app for further process.
1110: 			ipc_socket_rx_notify(ipc_socket);
1111: 		
1112: 		route_status = IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;  // return to indicate that cmd has reached target.
1113: 		// must return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK !!!!
1114: 		// because the communication is ok, the cmd result will be returned in RSP package.
1115: 	}
1116: 
1117: 	return route_status;
1118: }

1123: 	// it is a rsp, processed in API-implementation layer.

1137: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_cmd(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1138: {
1139: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * tx_ipc_socket = ipc_socket;
1140: 	
1141: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t	  rx_cmd;
1142: 
1143: 	// simulate the mailbox tx and rx process.
1144: 	
1145: 	// simulate local tx, (set tx flag). 
1146: 	// always tx successfully, because target resides in local cpu.
1147: 	ipc_socket->run_state |= STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;
1148: 
1149: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1150: 
1151: 	// simulate the target rx. 
1152: 	// copy mailbox data from device registers to statck variable.
1153: 	// memcpy(&rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(rx_cmd));  // receive the cmd.
1154: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1155: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1156: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1157: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1158: 
1159: 	ipc_cmd = &rx_cmd;
1160: 
1161: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the cmd.
1162: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1163: 
1164: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_cmd_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1165: 
1166: 	// simulate the local tx complete.
1167: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(tx_ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1168: 
1169: 	// always return tx success, cmd fail is handled in cmd tx_cmpl_handler.
1170: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1171: }

1173: static int ipc_socket_local_tx_rsp(mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket, mb_ipc_cmd_t *ipc_cmd)
1174: {
1175: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * tx_ipc_socket = ipc_socket;
1176: 	
1177: 	mb_ipc_cmd_t	  rx_cmd;
1178: 
1179: 	// simulate the mailbox tx and rx process.
1180: 
1181: 	ipc_socket_set_addr(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1182: 
1183: 	ipc_cmd->hdr.cmd |= MB_IPC_RSP_FLAG;   // set to rsp packet.
1184: 	
1185: 	// simulate the target rx. 
1186: 	// copy mailbox data from device registers to statck variable.
1187: 	// memcpy(&rx_cmd, ipc_cmd, sizeof(rx_cmd));  // receive the rsp.
1188: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.hdr.data = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.hdr.data;
1189: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param1 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param1;
1190: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param2 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param2;
1191: 	rx_cmd.mb_cmd.param3 = ipc_cmd->mb_cmd.param3;
1192: 
1193: 	ipc_cmd = &rx_cmd;
1194: 
1195: 	// find the ipc_socket connection for the rsp.
1196: 	ipc_socket = ipc_socket_search_recver(ipc_cmd->dst_port, ipc_cmd->src_cpu, ipc_cmd->src_port);
1197: 
1198: 	// must clear this flag before call peer side rx_rsp_handler.
1199: 	// because, perr side app may send another cmd immediately as soon as tx_in_process is cleared.
1200: 	// if not clear rx_in_process in this side in advances, peer side task may send fail.
1201: 	// tx_ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear rx_in_process.
1202: 
1203: 	// simulate the local tx complete. (will clear STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS in this function)
1204: 	ipc_socket_tx_cmpl_handler(tx_ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1205: 
1206: 	ipc_cmd->route_status = ipc_socket_rx_rsp_handler(ipc_socket, ipc_cmd);
1207: 	// (ipc_cmd->route_status) this status return is worthless but for debug.
1208: 	// so can clear STATE_RX_IN_PROCESS of tx_ipc_socket->run_state in advance.
1209: 
1210: 	// always return tx success, other fails are handled in tx_cmpl_handler.
1211: 	return IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK;
1212: }

1353: u32 mb_ipc_socket(u8 port, void * rx_callback)
1354: {
1355: 	mb_ipc_socket_handle_t   ipc_handle;
1356: 
1357: 	ipc_handle.data = 0;
1358: 
1359: 	int   port_idx = 0;
1360: 
1361: 	beken_semaphore_t  tx_semaphore = NULL;
1362: 	beken_semaphore_t  rx_semaphore = NULL;
1363: 
1364: 	rtos_init_semaphore(&tx_semaphore, 1);
1365: 	
1366: 	if(tx_semaphore == NULL)
1367: 	{
1368: 		return ipc_handle.data;
1369: 	}
1370: 
1371: 	if(rx_callback == NULL)  // not callback notification
1372: 	{
1373: 		rtos_init_semaphore(&rx_semaphore, 1);
1374: 		
1375: 		if(rx_semaphore == NULL)
1376: 		{
1377: 			rtos_deinit_semaphore(&tx_semaphore);
1378: 			
1379: 			return ipc_handle.data;
1380: 		}
1381: 	}
1382: 
1383: 	u32   temp = mb_ipc_enter_critical();
1384: 	
1385: 	port = ipc_allocate_port(port);
1386: 
1387: 	if(port == 0)
1388: 	{
1389: 		mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1390: 
1391: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&tx_semaphore);
1392: 		if(rx_semaphore != NULL)
1393: 		{
1394: 			rtos_deinit_semaphore(&rx_semaphore);
1395: 		}
1396: 
1397: 		return ipc_handle.data;
1398: 	}
1399: 
1400: 	if( IS_CLIENT_PORT(port) )
1401: 	{
1402: 		port_idx = port - CLIENT_PORT_MIN;
1403: 
1404: 		ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].tx_notify_sema = tx_semaphore;
1405: 
1406: 		if(rx_callback == NULL)
1407: 		{
1408: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].ctrl_mode |= CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // semaphore notification.
1409: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].rx_notify_sema = rx_semaphore;
1410: 		}
1411: 		else
1412: 		{
1413: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].ctrl_mode &= ~CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // callback notification.
1414: 			ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].rx_notify_isr = (mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)rx_callback;
1415: 		}
1416: 		
1417: 		ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].use_flag = USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED;
1418: 		ipc_handle.data = ipc_client_socket_tbl[port_idx].handle.data;
1419: 		
1420: 	}
1421: 	else if( IS_SERVER_PORT(port) )
1422: 	{
1423: 		port_idx = port - SERVER_PORT_MIN;
1424: 		
1425: 		// the same setting for all clients connected to this server.
1426: 		for(int j = 0; j < MAX_CONNET_PER_SVR; j++)
1427: 		{
1428: 			ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].tx_notify_sema = tx_semaphore;
1429: 
1430: 			if(rx_callback == NULL)
1431: 			{
1432: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].ctrl_mode |= CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // semaphore notification.
1433: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].rx_notify_sema = rx_semaphore;
1434: 			}
1435: 			else
1436: 			{
1437: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].ctrl_mode &= ~CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY; // callback notification.
1438: 				ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].rx_notify_isr = (mb_ipc_notify_isr_t)rx_callback;
1439: 			}
1440: 			
1441: 			ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][j].use_flag = USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED;
1442: 		}
1443: 		
1444: 		ipc_handle.data = ipc_server_socket_tbl[port_idx][0].handle.data;
1445: 	}
1446: 
1447: 	mb_ipc_exit_critical(temp);
1448: 
1449: 	return ipc_handle.data;
1450: }

1452: #define MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY		2
1453: #define MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX		1
1454: 
1455: int mb_ipc_connect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1456: {
1457: 	// data sanity check.
1458: 	if(IS_NOT_SERVER_PORT(dst_port))
1459: 	{
1460: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_PORT;
1461: 	}
1462: 	
1463: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1464: 
1465: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1466: 	{
1467: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1468: 	}
1469: 
1470: 	// data sanity check.
1471: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1472: 	{
1473: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1474: 	}
1475: 
1476: 	if(ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_CONNECTED)
1477: 	{
1478: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_STATE;
1479: 	}
1480: 
1481: 	// set the dst cpu-port firstly, because the tx_cmd/rx_rsp need these informations.
1482: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1483: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1484: 	
1485: 	ipc_socket->run_state = 0;
1486: 	ipc_socket->tx_status = 0;
1487: 	ipc_socket->rx_read_offset = 0;
1488: 
1489: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1490: 
1491: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_CONNECT_CMD;
1492: 
1493: 	u32   retry = 0;
1494: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1495: 
1496: 	do
1497: 	{
1498: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1499: 		
1500: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1501: 		
1502: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1503: 		{
1504: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1505: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1506: 		}
1507: 
1508: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1509: 		
1510: 		if(route_status != 0)
1511: 		{
1512: 			// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1513: 			mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1514: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1515: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1516: 			continue;
1517: 		}
1518: 		
1519: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1520: 		{
1521: 			ipc_socket->use_flag |= USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1522: 			return 0;
1523: 		}
1524: 		else
1525: 		{
1526: 			ret_val = -ipc_socket->tx_status;
1527: 			break;  // not retry.
1528: 		}
1529: 
1530: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1531: 
1532: 	// if(ret_val != 0)  // must be TRUE.
1533: 	{
1534: 		ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1535: 		ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;  // clear the connection.
1536: 	}
1537: 
1538: 	return ret_val;
1539: }

1541: int mb_ipc_disconnect(u32 handle, u8 dst_cpu, u8 dst_port, u32 time_out)
1542: {
1543: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1544: 
1545: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1546: 	{
1547: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1548: 	}
1549: 
1550: 	// data sanity check.
1551: 	if( (ipc_socket->use_flag & USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED) == 0 )
1552: 	{
1553: 		return -MB_IPC_NOT_INITED;
1554: 	}
1555: 
1556: 	if(dst_port == 0)
1557: 	{
1558: 		ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1559: 		return 0;
1560: 	}
1561: 
1562: 	ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = dst_cpu;
1563: 	ipc_socket->dst_port = dst_port;
1564: 	
1565: 	// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent previous cmd from being handled in ISR.
1566: 	mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1567: 
1568: 	memset(&ipc_socket->tx_cmd, 0, sizeof(ipc_socket->tx_cmd));
1569: 
1570: 	ipc_socket->tx_cmd.hdr.cmd = MB_IPC_DISCONNECT_CMD;
1571: 
1572: 	u32   retry = 0;
1573: 	int   ret_val = 0;
1574: 
1575: 	do
1576: 	{
1577: 		rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, 0);  // clear the semaphore state.
1578: 		
1579: 		int route_status = ipc_socket_tx_cmd(ipc_socket, &ipc_socket->tx_cmd, retry);
1580: 		
1581: 		if(route_status != IPC_ROUTE_STATUS_OK)
1582: 		{
1583: 			ret_val = -(MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + route_status);
1584: 			break;  // not retry for router error.
1585: 		}
1586: 
1587: 		route_status = rtos_get_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema, time_out);
1588: 		
1589: 		if(route_status != 0)
1590: 		{
1591: 			// ipc_socket->run_state &= ~STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS;  // clear tx_in_process. prevent cmd from being handled in ISR.
1592: 			mb_atomic_clear(&ipc_socket->run_state, STATE_TX_IN_PROCESS);
1593: 			ret_val = -MB_IPC_TX_TIMEOUT;
1594: 			// rtos_delay_milliseconds(MB_IPC_RETRY_DELAY);
1595: 			continue;
1596: 		}
1597: 
1598: 		if(ipc_socket->dst_port == 0)
1599: 		{
1600: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1601: 			return 0;
1602: 		}
1603: 
1604: 		if(ipc_socket->tx_status == MB_IPC_TX_OK)
1605: 		{
1606: 			ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1607: 			ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;
1608: 			
1609: 			ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1610: 			return 0;
1611: 		}
1612: 		else
1613: 		{
1614: 			if( (ipc_socket->tx_status > MB_IPC_API_BASE_FAILED) || 
1615: 				(ipc_socket->tx_status == (MB_IPC_ROUTE_BASE_FAILED + IPC_ROUTE_UNREACHABLE)) )
1616: 			{
1617: 				ipc_socket->dst_cpu  = 0;
1618: 				ipc_socket->dst_port = 0;
1619: 
1620: 				ipc_socket->use_flag &= ~USE_FLAG_CONNECTED;
1621: 				return 0;
1622: 			}
1623: 			return -ipc_socket->tx_status;  // not retry.
1624: 		}
1625: 	} while((ret_val != 0) && (++retry < MB_IPC_RETRY_MAX));
1626: 
1627: 	return ret_val;
1628: }

1630: int mb_ipc_close(u32 handle, u32 time_out)
1631: {
1632: 	mb_ipc_socket_t * ipc_socket = get_socket_from_handle(handle);
1633: 
1634: 	if(ipc_socket == NULL)
1635: 	{
1636: 		return -MB_IPC_INVALID_HANDLE;
1637: 	}
1638: 
1639: 	int result = mb_ipc_disconnect(handle, ipc_socket->dst_cpu, ipc_socket->dst_port, time_out);
1640: 
1641: 	if(result != 0)
1642: 	{
1643: 		return result;
1644: 	}
1645: 
1646: 	if(IS_SERVER_PORT(ipc_socket->src_port))
1647: 	{
1648: 		// all server sockets share the same resources.
1649: 		// server sockets are not closed, so can't free any resources.
1650: 		return 0;
1651: 	}
1652: 	
1653: 	// free resources.
1654: 	rtos_deinit_semaphore(&ipc_socket->tx_notify_sema);
1655: 
1656: 	if(ipc_socket->ctrl_mode & CTRL_RX_SEMA_NOTIFY)
1657: 	{
1658: 		rtos_deinit_semaphore(&ipc_socket->rx_notify_sema);
1659: 	}
1660: 	
1661: 	ipc_socket->use_flag = 0;   // &= ~(USE_FLAG_CONNECTED | USE_FLAG_ALLOCATED); // disconnected, socket closed.
1662: 	
1663: 	return 0;
1664: }

61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64: 
65: 	if (mbox0_drv_get_send_count(dst, &fifo_count) != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
66: 		return;
67: 
68: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
69: 	if (fifo_count != 0)
70: 	{
71: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{
98: 		reaped += slots->ack_used[i] != 0;
99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}
101: 	reaped += slots->reset_used != 0;
102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
107: 	adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
108: }

135: static mbox0_stable_slot_t *mbox0_alloc_slot(u8 dst, u8 ctrl,

144: 			return NULL;
145: 		slots->reset_used = 1;
146: 		slots->reset_order = ++slots->publish_order;
147: 		*kind = 2;
148: 		return &slots->reset;
149: 	}
150: 
151: 	if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
152: 	{
153: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
154: 		{
155: 			if (!slots->ack_used[i])
156: 			{
157: 				slots->ack_used[i] = 1;
158: 				slots->ack_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
159: 				*kind = 1;
160: 				*index = i;
161: 				return &slots->ack[i];
162: 			}
163: 		}
164: 		return NULL;
165: 	}
166: 
167: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_SYNC_TX)
168: 	{
169: 		if (slots->sync_used)
170: 			return NULL;
171: 		slots->sync_used = 1;
172: 		slots->sync_order = ++slots->publish_order;
173: 		*kind = 3;
174: 		return &slots->sync;
175: 	}
176: 
177: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
178: 	{
179: 		if (!slots->cmd_used[i])
180: 		{
181: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 1;
182: 			slots->cmd_order[i] = ++slots->publish_order;
183: 			slots->cmd_active = i + 1;
184: 			*kind = 0;
185: 			*index = i;
186: 			return &slots->cmd[i];
187: 		}
188: 	}
189: 
190: 	return NULL;

250: 			mailbox_callback[desc.source](&desc.data);

252: 		flags = rtos_disable_int();
253: 		mbox0_drv_poll();
254: 		rtos_enable_int(flags);

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;
266: 
267: 	if (!msg)
268: 		return;
269: 
270: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
271: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
272: 	{
273: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if ((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		adapter_diag.last_cmd_header = desc->data.param0;
325: 		adapter_diag.cmd_received++;
326: 	}
327: 	if (ctrl == 0)
328: 	{
329: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
330: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
331: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
332: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
333: 		{
334: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
335: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
336: 		}
337: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
338: 	}
339: 	desc->source = source;
340: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
341: 	desc->used = 1;
342: 	rx_count++;
343: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;
344: 
345: 	/* The vendor adapter dispatches the logical callback from the mailbox
346: 	 * receive path.  Keep ACK generation in the same interrupt transaction;
347: 	 * delaying it until mb_chnl_poll() can stall AP bring-up. */
348: 	if (mailbox_callback[source] != NULL)
349: 	{
350: 		adapter_diag.callback_called++;
351: 		mailbox_callback[source](&desc->data);
352: 	}
353: 	else
354: 		adapter_diag.callback_missing++;
355: 
356: 	desc->used = 0;
357: 	rx_count--;
358: 
359: }

391: bk_err_t bk_mailbox_send(mailbox_data_t *data, mailbox_endpoint_t src,
392: 			 mailbox_endpoint_t dst, void *arg)
393: {
394: 	mbox0_message_t message;
395: 	mbox0_stable_slot_t *slot;
396: 	uint32_t fifo_status;
397: 	u8 ctrl;
398: 	u8 kind = 0;
399: 	u8 index = 0;
400: 	int ret_code;
401: 
402: 	(void)arg;
403: 	if (src != MAILBOX_CPU0 || dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
404: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
405: 	if (!data)
406: 		return BK_ERR_NULL_PARAM;
407: 
408: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_get_send_stat(dst, &fifo_status);
409: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
410: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_SRC_DST;
411: 	if (fifo_status & RX_FIFO_STAT_FULL)
412: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_TIMEOUT;
413: 
414: 	ctrl = (data->param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
415: 	mbox0_reap_slots(dst);
416: 	slot = mbox0_alloc_slot(dst, ctrl, &kind, &index);
417: 	if (!slot)
418: 	{
419: 		adapter_diag.tx_slot_busy++;
420: 		return BK_ERR_BUSY;
421: 	}
422: 
423: 	memset(slot, 0, sizeof(*slot));
424: 	memcpy(&slot->data, data, sizeof(slot->data));
425: 	mailbox_slots[dst].fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;
426: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
427: 	SCB_CleanDCache_by_Addr((u32 *)slot, sizeof(*slot));
428: #endif
429: 	__DMB();
430: 	message.data[0] = (u32)&slot->data;
431: 	message.data[1] = sizeof(slot->data);
432: 	message.dest_cpu = dst;
433: 	ret_code = mbox0_drv_send_message(&message);
434: 	if (ret_code != MBOX0_HAL_OK)
435: 	{
436: 		mbox0_release_slot(dst, kind, index);
437: 		if (ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
438: 			adapter_diag.ack_send_fail++;
439: 		return BK_ERR_MAILBOX_NOT_INIT;
440: 	}
441: 	if (ctrl == MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX)
442: 	{
443: 		adapter_diag.last_ack_header = slot->data.param0;
444: 		adapter_diag.ack_sent++;
445: 	}
446: 	return BK_OK;
447: }

449: void bk_mailbox_tx_complete(mailbox_endpoint_t dst)
450: {
451: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
452: 	u32 completed_order;
453: 	u8 i;
454: 
455: 	if (dst >= MBOX_CHNL_NUM)
456: 		return;
457: 	slots = &mailbox_slots[dst];
458: 	if (!slots->cmd_active)
459: 		return;
460: 	completed_order = slots->cmd_order[slots->cmd_active - 1];
461: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
462: 	{
463: 		if (slots->ack_used[i] && slots->ack_order[i] < completed_order)
464: 			slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
465: 	}
466: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
467: 	{
468: 		if (slots->cmd_used[i] && slots->cmd_order[i] <= completed_order)
469: 			slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
470: 	}
471: 	if (slots->reset_used && slots->reset_order < completed_order)
472: 		slots->reset_used = 0;
473: 	if (slots->sync_used && slots->sync_order < completed_order)
474: 		slots->sync_used = 0;
475: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;

59: 	mbox0_tx_slots_t *slots;
60: 	uint32_t fifo_count;
61: 	u32 reaped = 0;
62: 	u32 now;
63: 	u8 i;
64:

66: 		return;

72: 		return;
73: 	}
74: 
75: 	now = rtos_get_time();
76: 	if (!slots->fifo_empty_since_ms)
77: 	{
78: 		slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = now ? now : 1;
79: 		return;
80: 	}
81: 	if ((u32)(now - slots->fifo_empty_since_ms) <
82: 		MBOX0_SLOT_QUARANTINE_MS)
83: 		return;
84: 
85: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_CMD_SLOT_NUM; i++)
86: 	{
87: 		reaped += slots->cmd_used[i] != 0;
88: 		slots->cmd_used[i] = 0;
89: 	}
90: 	/* The hardware FIFO contains pointers into these slots.  Once it has
91: 	 * remained empty for the quarantine interval, the peer has had ample time
92: 	 * to copy every published entry.  ACK-only AP traffic has no later command
93: 	 * fence, so retaining these slots indefinitely exhausts the pool during
94: 	 * RESET/STATE/PWC bring-up.
95: 	 */
96: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
97: 	{

99: 		slots->ack_used[i] = 0;
100: 	}

102: 	reaped += slots->sync_used != 0;
103: 	slots->reset_used = 0;
104: 	slots->sync_used = 0;
105: 	slots->cmd_active = 0;
106: 	slots->fifo_empty_since_ms = 0;

258: static void mbox0_rx_isr(mbox0_message_t *msg)
259: {
260: 	u32 address;
261: 	u32 source;
262: 	u32 reaped = 0;
263: 	mbox0_rx_desc_t *desc;
264: 	u8 ctrl;
265: 	u8 i;
266: 
267: 	if (!msg)
268: 		return;

270: 	source = msg->src_cpu;
271: 	if (source != MAILBOX_CPU1)
272: 	{
273: 		adapter_diag.bad_sid++;
274: 		return;
275: 	}
276: 	if (msg->data[1] != sizeof(mailbox_data_t))
277: 	{
278: 		adapter_diag.bad_length++;
279: 		return;
280: 	}
281: 
282: 	address = msg->data[0];
283: 	if (address & 0x3u)
284: 	{
285: 		adapter_diag.bad_alignment++;
286: 		return;
287: 	}
288: 	if (address > UINT32_MAX - sizeof(mailbox_data_t) ||
289: 		address < MBOX0_AP_RAM_START ||
290: 		address + sizeof(mailbox_data_t) > MBOX0_AP_RAM_END)
291: 	{
292: 		adapter_diag.bad_address++;
293: 		return;
294: 	}
295: 	if (rx_count >= MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM)
296: 	{
297: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
298: 		return;
299: 	}
300: 
301: #if CONFIG_CACHE_ENABLE
302: 	SCB_InvalidateDCache_by_Addr((void *)address, sizeof(mailbox_data_t));
303: #endif
304: 	__DMB();
305: 	desc = NULL;
306: 	for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_RX_DESC_NUM; i++)
307: 	{
308: 		if (!rx_desc[i].used)
309: 		{
310: 			desc = &rx_desc[i];
311: 			break;
312: 		}
313: 	}
314: 	if (!desc)
315: 	{
316: 		adapter_diag.descriptor_overflow++;
317: 		return;
318: 	}
319: 	memcpy(&desc->data, (void *)address, sizeof(desc->data));
320: 	adapter_diag.last_rx_header = desc->data.param0;
321: 	ctrl = (desc->data.param0 >> 12) & 0x0f;
322: 	if ((ctrl & MBOX0_CTRL_ACK_BOX) == 0)
323: 	{
324: 		adapter_diag.last_cmd_header = desc->data.param0;
325: 		adapter_diag.cmd_received++;
326: 	}
327: 	if (ctrl == 0)
328: 	{
329: 		/* AP serializes ordinary logical commands.  Receiving the next one
330: 		 * proves that it copied the preceding CP transport ACK, providing an
331: 		 * exact lifetime fence even during a continuous UART/PWC burst. */
332: 		for (i = 0; i < MBOX0_ACK_SLOT_NUM; i++)
333: 		{
334: 			reaped += mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] != 0;
335: 			mailbox_slots[source].ack_used[i] = 0;
336: 		}
337: 		adapter_diag.tx_reaped += reaped;
338: 	}
339: 	desc->source = source;
340: 	desc->order = ++rx_order;
341: 	desc->used = 1;
342: 	rx_count++;
343: 	adapter_diag.rx_accepted++;

345: 	/* The vendor adapter dispatches the logical callback from the mailbox
346: 	 * receive path.  Keep ACK generation in the same interrupt transaction;
347: 	 * delaying it until mb_chnl_poll() can stall AP bring-up. */
348: 	if (mailbox_callback[source] != NULL)
349: 	{
350: 		adapter_diag.callback_called++;
351: 		mailbox_callback[source](&desc->data);
352: 	}
353: 	else
354: 		adapter_diag.callback_missing++;
355: 
356: 	desc->used = 0;
357: 	rx_count--;

234:         if (s_secondary_cb && s_secondary_cb->send)
235:         {
236:             s_secondary_cb->send(buf, len);
237:         }
238:     }
239: 
240:     return ret;
241: }
